articleTitle: Application of V2G Dynamic Electricity Price Optimization Algorithm Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning in Emergency Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article proposes a vehicle-to-grid integration (V2G) dynamic electricity tariff optimization algorithm rooted in deep reinforcement learning (DRL), aiming to solve the issue of power system load balancing and efficient scheduling in emergency scenarios. The algorithm adopts a deep Q-grid (DQN) structure. By continuously studying the behavioral paradigm of electric vehicles in the charging and discharging process, it combines the real-time demands of the power grid and dynamically adjusts the electricity bill policy to improve the overall operating performance of the V2G system. To be precise, the algorithm builds a modality-action-reward mechanism to monitor the evolution of grid load and vehicle charging demand in real time, and adjust electricity charges based on dynamic changes in power supply and demand. In this way, the system cannot only effectively equalize supply and demand, but also maximize the operational stability and efficiency of the power grid. To verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, this article conceives simulation experiments under various emergency situations. The results show that the proposed algorithm can significantly reduce the peak load of the system and increase the power scheduling capacity under various emergency conditions. Compared with the conventional fixed electricity tariff policy, the electricity tariff control accuracy of this formula jumps by 15%, and the power scheduling efficiency increases by 20%.

articleTitle: CScGAN: Leveraging Compressed Sensing and Generative Adversarial Networks for Image Super-Resolution Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: We propose a novel image super-resolution technique, the Compressive Sensing combined with Generative Adversarial Network model (CScGAN). During the image super-resolution reconstruction process, artifacts that arise from the complexity of the reconstruction network, imbalances in training data, and instability in the training process can degrade the quality of the reconstructed images. Our method concentrates on minimizing reconstruction artifacts through advanced signal processing and structural optimization of the network. We elucidate our CScGAN model using architectural diagrams and mathematical notation. When compared with multiple public datasets and state-of-the-art methods, our approach significantly reduces the impact of artifacts during the reconstruction process and enhances the quality of the reconstructed images.

articleTitle: A Novel Ant Colony and Sparrow Search Optimization-Based Routing Algorithm for LEO Satellite Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To improve the convergence capability of ant colony routing in LEO satellite networks, a novel hybrid ant colony-sparrow search optimization routing algorithm is proposed. The sparrow algorithm is used to identify local optimal solutions in the ACO routing process and guide the algorithm to re-converge. Simulation results show that, compared to the traditional ACO algorithm, the proposed algorithm significantly improves communication delay and reduces communication costs.

articleTitle: T1 Test Bench Design Based on LabVIEW for Daya Bay Nuclear Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The reactor protection system is one of the most important safety systems in nuclear plant. In order to ensure the availability of the system, and according to the requirements of nuclear safety regulations, it is necessary to conduct regular tests on the system's functions in order to timely detect potential faults within the system. And the aging and reduced reliability of the test bench at Daya Bay Nuclear plant have affected the safety of the nuclear plant. In this paper, T1 test bench is designed based on LabVIEW, including hardware and software design. And the T1 test bench have operated in Daya Bay nuclear plant more than one year demonstrated that this new tester meets the expected requirement.

articleTitle: Research on Multimodal Data Fusion and Analysis Methods Driven by Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, a new Depth Mixed-RESnet (DM-RN) model is proposed through multi-mode fusion, which aims to organically integrate the logic of depth-first search (DFS) algorithm, the residual learning advantage of ResNet and the Mixed attention (MA) mechanism, so as to promote the research of multi-modal data fusion and analysis methods driven by knowledge graph. The DM-RN model optimizes the depth traversal of the network structure by DFS strategy to ensure the effective transmission of information. Combined with ResNet residual connection, the problem of gradient disappearance in deep network training can be effectively alleviated and the representation ability of the model can be improved. Mixed attention mechanism is introduced to enhance the ability of the model to capture key information in multi-modal data. Finally, by comparing with traditional multi-module data, the experimental results show that DM-RN method has significant advantages in improving the accuracy of multi-mode data fusion and analysis and accelerating the loss function. This method can not only integrate heterogeneous data from multiple sources efficiently, but also improve the analysis accuracy and generalization performance.

articleTitle: Fault Characteristics Analysis of Grid-Connected Ship Power System with Distributed Photovoltaic Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The access of distributed photovoltaic with high permeability will lead to significant changes in the fault characteristics of distribution network. This paper takes the grid-connected power system of distributed photovoltaic power supply on a demonstration ship as the research object, and analyzes the fault characteristics of distributed photovoltaic access and short circuit current. The change of fault characteristics and short-circuit current in different segments before and after the failure of PV power supply when it is connected to 440V bus and 230V bus are studied.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Photovoltaic Autonomous Optimization Control Strategy Under the Guidance of Voltage Optimization Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper innovatively describes a decentralized light energy self-regulation strategy rooted in the voltage optimization law. The scheme comprehensively considers the transient characteristics and decentralized pattern of light conversion, integrates GA (genetic algorithm) and PSO (particle swarm optimization) to build a hybrid optimization framework, and is committed to achieving the optimal regulation of photovoltaic production capacity based on ensuring the steady state of the power storage architecture. The first step is to conceive a voltage optimization blueprint specifically for decentralized light energy, whose function is to flexibly adjust the photovoltaic power consumption quota according to the real-time operating conditions of the power distribution network. With the help of the composite algorithm of GA superimposed on PSO, the cyclic refinement of the self-regulation strategy is realized. The results of simulation experiments show that this method can effectively reduce the degree of voltage fluctuation, enhance the robustness of photovoltaic equipment connected to the power grid, and simultaneously increase the overall efficiency of the system. Detailed numerical comparison shows that after adopting this method, the system voltage deviation from the standard value is reduced by as much as 12.3%, and the light-to-electricity efficiency ratio is increased to 8.6%. Compared with the previous control methods, the strategy presented in this paper has obvious advantages in voltage improvement and energy utilization efficiency. This study provides key insights for the optimized control of distributed solar energy connected to the grid.

articleTitle: Multidimensional Static Code Analysis Method for Automotive Software
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The accelerated development of automotive intelligence and connectivity has raised higher requirements for the quality and security of automotive software code. In this paper, a multi-dimensional static code analysis method is proposed by integrating lexical analysis with rule verification. This method employs Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) technology, data flow and control flow analysis techniques, combined with parallel analysis technology, to achieve comprehensive, accurate, and efficient static analysis of source code. Through comparative experimental validation, the static code analysis tool designed in this paper exhibits excellent performance in detection accuracy, efficiency, compatibility, and reliability, providing strong support for quality control and risk management in the software development process.

articleTitle: Transformer Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Data Feature Expansion and GSA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the status quo that transformer fault diagnosis has low precision and poor accuracy, and manual fault detection is still used in production, this paper proposes a transformer fault diagnosis method based on data feature extension and Gravity Search Algorithm (GSA) improved Support Vector Machine (SVM). First, the features are extended to 20 dimensions using the feature ratio method. Second, the features are optimized using the random forest (RF) algorithm to remove redundant features, reduce data complexity, and improve the accuracy and prediction speed of the prediction results. Finally, the improved support vector machine model (GSA-SVM) using the gravitational search algorithm is used to optimize the prediction model and predict the data, and its prediction result has an F1 score of 88.2%, which is more accurate than the models of several other algorithms. The results show that the method can diagnose faults quickly and accurately, and has some practical significance in the field of transformer fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Study on Power Density Enhancement of Coupling Mechanism of WPT System Under S-S Topology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The traditional limited charging system has gradually failed to meet the various power needs of electric vehicles, and the wireless energy transmission technology, with its high efficiency, safety, flexibility and convenience, is gradually becoming an effective solution for electric vehicles in complex power scenarios. This paper comprehensively analyzes the problem of low power density of electric vehicle wireless charging technology in practical application. The electromagnetic analysis method and loss analysis method of three aspects, such as wireless charging compensation network, coupling mechanism coil structure and coupling mechanism magnetic pad, are given. And through simulation experiments, it is verified that the volume of the coupling mechanism is reduced by 10.78%; the occupied space is reduced by 6.54%; and the mass is reduced by 11.60% after suitable magnetic core replacement. The feasibility of nanocrystalline materials in improving the power density of the coupling mechanism is demonstrated.

articleTitle: YOLO-Based Obstacle Detection Under Few-Shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The obstacle detection industry has been developing rapidly in recent years. Obstacle detection technology has grown by leaps and bounds. Few-shot obstacle detection has a profound significance, which can help us to solve the problem of small samples under high speed conditions in target detection. Due to the limitation of the shooting environment, the sample size about the obstacles is small today. The goal of small sample learning is not for the machine to recognize images in the training set and generalize to the test set; the goal of small sample learning is for the machine to learn to learn on its own. The purpose of learning is for the model to understand the similarities and differences between things and learn to distinguish between them. In this paper, we help with this process by adding a parameter reweighting module. The models will fall into overfitting when a small number of samples are available. In this paper, we propose a small-sample detection method based on improved YOLO-v8. For the problem of small sample size, we improve the generalization ability of the model by adding an attention mechanism at the detection header, and for the problem of model overfitting, we update the model parameters by adding a feature reweighting module to improve the model effect. Finally, the proposed method is validated based on the track area dataset, and the experimental results show that the model can realize the accurate recognition of small sample obstacles.

articleTitle: A Transient Switching Modeling Method for IGBT Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes an IGBT transient switching modeling approach based on transfer learning, designed to enhance modeling efficiency and accuracy while reducing reliance on extensive data and complex parameter extraction. The study uses two IGBT modules with similar specifications as case examples. Data under various operating conditions were collected using the industrial simulation tool L Tspice, resulting in a source dataset and a target dataset, with the target dataset comprising only 13.43% of the size of the source dataset. Initially, a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) neural network is pre-trained on the source dataset to capture the fundamental switching behaviors of the IGBTs. Subsequently, the pre-trained model is fine-tuned through transfer learning to adapt it to the specific target IGBT module using the target dataset. The model's performance is evaluated using the relative root mean square error (RMSE). The results demonstrate that this method can accurately replicate IGBT transient switching characteristics with limited data, offering an efficient and robust solution for IGBT transient modeling in power electronic systems.

articleTitle: A Survey of Neural Network Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper aims to explore seven commonly used optimization algorithms in deep learning: SGD, Momentum-SGD, NAG, AdaGrad, RMSprop, AdaDelta, and Adam. Based on an overview of their theories and development histories, this paper constructs convolutional neural networks and BERT to conduct numerical experiments on these optimization algorithms. The experimental results show that among the seven optimization algorithms, SGD may get stuck in saddle points, while the other six algorithms developed based on SGD have the ability to escape from saddle points. Compared to other algorithms, Adam converges the fastest and the parameters obtained perform better in practice.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Characteristics of a Scaled-Down Single-Phase Four-Column Autotransformer Calculation Excited by DC Currents
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Single-phase four-column autotransformer is the key equipment of the extra-high voltage power grid, and its safe and steady operation is directly related to the security of the power system. By using different DC voltage sources represents various strengths of transformer DC bias, this paper proposes an model that combines finite element magnetic field model and equivalent circuit model to investigate the electromagnetic characteristics of single-phase, four-column autotransformer excited by DC bias, which is field-circuit coupled model. A DC bias parameter that denotes the strength of transformer DC bias is introduced, the simulation results under different DC bias parameters show that when excited by DC, there is an enhancement in the magnetic flux density of the core, and the distortion of the exciting currents waveform, with the even harmonics most significantly increasing in amplitude. The conclusion drawn is that GICs can significantly increase the content of harmonics and magnetic flux density of the core.

articleTitle: Construction of an Electric Energy Prediction Model Based on Improved IHHO-RF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, machine learning, as its core branch, can effectively solve prediction problems by learning and extracting patterns from large amounts of data. Algorithms play a key role in this process. AI technologies will show great potential in a wider range of application scenarios in the future. Therefore, an improved Harris Eagle Algorithm (IHHO) is proposed, which is combined with the construction of a coupling algorithm based on random forest model (IHHO-RF) and applied to predict the power output of cyclic power plants. Firstly, on the original Harris Eagle algorithm, a Harris Eagle algorithm based on the best point set theory, stochastic shrinkage index and adaptive inertia weight was proposed, and 10 Benchmark functions were used to test the effectiveness of the algorithm. Secondly, the IHHO algorithm is combined with random forest to form a parallel ensemble algorithm, and it is applied to the construction of the prediction model of the power output of the cyclic power plant. The results show that the prediction accuracy of the improved IHHO-RF model has significant advantages compared with the HHO-RF and other models, and the parallel ensemble algorithm constructed with the random forest model can achieve more accurate prediction tasks and has the ability to be widely promoted.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of a Database for the Main Research Contents of Vehicle Evaluation Based on Multi-Source Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This research focuses on constructing a comprehensive repository for vehicle assessment studies, leveraging diverse data sources to enhance the precision and thoroughness of vehicle evaluations. The research introduced a multi-source data amalgamation algorithm capable of efficiently merging various data streams, including sensor readings, user input, and past operational records. This algorithm employs techniques such as the weighted average method, fuzzy logic, and machine learning to preserve the inherent attributes of the data during the fusion process and to refine the accuracy of the evaluation outcomes. To validate the algorithm's effectiveness, extensive experiments were conducted in a simulated environment, where the algorithm's performance was evaluated across varying data dimensions and levels of noise. The results from the simulations indicate that the algorithm excels in monitoring vehicle conditions and assessing performance, achieving an error margin below 5%, and demonstrating robust capability in handling noisy data, thereby ensuring the dependability of the evaluation results. Furthermore, people established a structured database to archive and manage the processed data, facilitating rapid retrieval and analysis. The database is intricately connected with the algorithm, guaranteeing the system's ability to efficiently manage large-scale data and deliver precise decision-making support for vehicle assessments.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Adaptive Optimization Model System of Computing System Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper achieves the dynamic optimization of system performance through the application of Q-learning and deep reinforcement learning (DQN). In traditional systems, decision-making mechanisms often lack self-adjusting capabilities for various requirements. By using adaptive optimization techniques, the system can make real-time adjustments according to the feedback from the operating environment, thus optimizing the decision-making process. The system is mainly composed of two parts: algorithm design and model simulation. Simulation results indicate that in multiple test scenarios, this system significantly enhances the operational efficiency and performance. Data analysis reveals that compared with traditional static mechanisms, the system's task completion rate has increased by 15% and the operation time has been reduced by 12 %. Moreover, the universality of the adaptive optimization mechanism in different operating scenarios has been verified through precise analysis of simulation data. In conclusion, this study demonstrates that the adaptive system optimization based on reinforcement learning can not only remarkably improve the performance of individualized decision-making, but also provide effective theoretical support and technical reference for the design of future intelligent systems.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Docking Method of Cabin Segments for Tandem-parallel Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The method of automatic segment docking using a series-parallel mechanism is studied. Firstly, the position deviation of the mobile and fixed segments is converted into the position deviation of the initial and target positions of the tandem-parallel mechanism by using the two-dimensional projection geometry method of the measurement system; then, a multi-objective attitude trajectory optimization model is set up, and the B-spline trajectory parameters are obtained by using the improved Salp Swarm Algorithm (SSA) and fuzzy evaluation method when the values of the objective functions are the average optimal values so that the attitude trajectory and the motion trajectories of each joint of the attitude platform for achieving the docking of segments can be planned out. The B-spline trajectory parameters are obtained when the value of each objective function is the average optimum, and the motion trajectories of each joint are planned out to realize the docking of the module; finally, the test result is that the module can reach the target position with “one measurement and one adjustment”, which fully proves that the method has high effectiveness and practicability in guiding the series-parallel mechanism to realize the docking of the module.

articleTitle: PCB Defect Detection Based on YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the electronics manufacturing industry, the quality and reliability of printed circuit boards (PCBs) have become key factors in the performance of electronic products. Traditional PCB defect detection methods suffer from low efficiency and inaccurate results. This paper proposes a PCB defect detection method based on the YOLOv5s algorithm, aiming to improve the efficiency and accuracy of detection. YOLOv5s, as a lightweight real-time object detection model, is particularly suitable for automated detection tasks. This paper provides a detailed introduction to the basic structure and network design of the YOLOv5s model, including the Input, Backbone, Neck, and Head, and discusses its application in PCB defect detection. Through experimental design, we used an open-source PCB image dataset provided by the Peking University Intelligent Robotics Open Lab and trained and evaluated the model. The experimental results show that the model achieves high precision and recall rates in PCB defect detection, with a high mean Average Precision (mAP) value, demonstrating excellent performance. This study not only optimizes the quality control process of PCBs but also provides strong technical support for the automation and intelligent upgrading of the electronics manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Edge-Guided Human Depth Image Inpainting Based on Diffusion Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the context of depth images, fusing human segmentation images with depth background images provides critical data for human detection tasks, where accurate localization of the human head is a key indicator. However, in real-world scenarios with occlusions and complex backgrounds, human segmentation images often lack head pixels. This missing data leads to subpar performance in human recognition tasks for deep learning models. To address this issue, this paper proposes an efficient approach that combines edge detection, projection analysis, and template matching for upper-body localization and head identification. Additionally, a refined diffusion model is used to repair the human head edge mask obtained from the initial processing. The main advantage of this approach is its independence from complex deep learning model training. It integrates traditional image processing techniques, morphological analysis, and diffusion models, simplifying head localization and effectively avoiding interference from the shoulder and arm regions. This approach enables more accurate head localization and uses diffusion models to restore missing portions of the human head, thereby improving overall pose recognition accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that the repaired depth images outperform the original images in human pose model training. When trained with the repaired images, detection accuracy (mAPVal50-95) and precision improved by 10.1 % and 7.1%, respectively, significantly enhancing downstream object detection performance. These findings validate the effectiveness of the proposed method in repairing missing human head depth images. They further highlight its potential in improving pose recognition and object detection performance, offering reliable technical support for related tasks.

articleTitle: Underwater DOA Estimator Based on Variational Bayesian Inference with Non-uniform Noise
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In complex underwater communication environments, Gaussian white noise models often fail to capture the true characteristics of the ocean environment accurately. Especially for low-frequency signals, the relative increase in array aperture leads to differences in the noise variance received between array elements, resulting in a decrease in the precision of the direction of arrival (DOA) estimator. Therefore, we innovatively propose a non-uniform noise Bayesian framework to address this challenge. Within this framework, the received signal is regarded as a synthesis of the expected signal and non-uniform noise. Subsequently, we employ the variational Bayesian inference (VBI) to learn the hyperparameters and use the first-order Taylor linear expansion to address the modeling error. The results of simulation experiments confirm that the proposed method demonstrates excellent performance compared to the existing algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimization of Bayesian Statistical Model Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper investigates the optimization of Bayesian statistical models using deep learning techniques. We introduce the theoretical basis of Bayesian models and deep learning, and propose a novel framework for their integration. Our methodology involves selecting appropriate deep learning models and developing an algorithmic approach for parameter optimization. The paper presents experimental results, demonstrating the effectiveness of the optimized models through comparative analysis. We also include five key visualizations to illustrate our findings. The study concludes with a discussion on the limitations and potential for future research, highlighting the significance of our approach in advancing Bayesian model optimization.

articleTitle: Research on Blockchain Implementation Algorithm for Decentralized Identity Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the implementation of decentralized identity authentication system and designs an innovative algorithm based on blockchain technology, aiming to improve the security, privacy and decentralization of the system. The algorithm proposed in this study implements encrypted storage and distributed authentication of identity data through distributed ledger and smart contracts of blockchain, ensuring the privacy and data security of users. The hash function and zero-knowledge proof method are introduced, so that the user's identity information does not need to be transmitted in plain text during the verification process, further improving the security of the authentication process. The model simulation part uses real data sets to test the system many times, covering key performance indicators such as response time, authentication success rate, throughput and system load. The experimental results show that while ensuring security, the system's response speed has improved by about 18%. The authentication success rate is more than 99%, and it still maintains high stability under high concurrency conditions. These results verify the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed algorithm, and provide theoretical and technical support for the application of decentralized identity authentication system in the future.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Coupling Mechanism Loss in Wireless Power Transfer Systems Based on Partitioned Computation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In a magnetically coupled wireless power transfer (WPT) system, the coupling mechanism experiences coil losses, core losses, and aluminum plate losses due to high-frequency currents during operation. Establishing an accurate loss model can guide the design of the coupling mechanism and help reduce energy losses. This paper employs finite element simulation software and utilizes a partitioned computation method to optimize the loss model of the coupling mechanism. The optimized model offers higher precision, with simulation results more closely aligning with the actual system losses.

articleTitle: Image Steganography Without Embedding Based on Style Transfer and Zero-Watermarking
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Currently, most of the existing steganography approaches are built on the basis of embedding. Regardless of how good the cover picture is chosen or how skillful it is, it will result in a variation of the cover image and arouse the suspect of the attacker. This paper presents a new method of non-embedding image steganography in order to accomplish the secret transport task. Firstly, the sender uses the Quaternion Polar Harmonic Fourier Moments (QPHFM) stabilization properties to carry out the key of the primary image. Then, based on the style transfer network, the format of the original cover image is modified and used to transmit on the common channel. As for the receiver, a special destylization network is adopted in the receiver to reconstruct the raw image. Then, we use a key to get the hidden message from the reconstruction of the original image. In the entire transfer, there is no embedding of the secret message, and it is known as non-embedding image steganography. Moreover, even if the key is broken, it will not be taken away by the attacker. The wide range of experiments show that this method is able to accomplish the security and success of secret transfer.

articleTitle: Comparing Image Segmentation Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for denoising binary images using simulated annealing (SA), a global optimization technique that addresses the inherent challenges of non-convex energy functions. Binary images are often corrupted by noise, necessitating effective restoration methods. We propose an energy function <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$E(x, y)$</tex> that captures the relationship between the noisy image <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$y$</tex> and the desired clean image <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$x$</tex>. Our algorithm combines simulated annealing with a localized optimization strategy to efficiently navigate the solution space, minimizing the energy function while maintaining computational efficiency. We evaluate the performance of the proposed method against traditional iterative conditional modes (ICM), employing a binary image with 10% pixel corruption as a test case. Experimental results demonstrate that the simulated annealing method achieves a significant restoration improvement, yielding a 99.19% agree-ment with the original image compared to 96.21 % for ICM. Visual assessments reveal that simulated annealing effectively removes noise while preserving structural details, making it a promising approach for binary image denoising. This work contributes to the field of image processing by highlighting the advantages of incorporating global optimization techniques in restoration tasks.

articleTitle: Research on the LLM-Driven Vulnerability Detection System Using LProtector
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The security issues of large-scale software systems and frameworks have become increasingly severe with the development of technology. As complexity of software grows, vulnerabilities are becoming more challenging to detect. Although traditional machine learning methods have been applied in cybersecurity for a long time, there has been no significant breakthrough until now. With the recent rise of large language models (LLMs), a turning point seems to have arrived. The powerful code comprehension and generation capabilities of LLMs make fully automated vulnerability detection systems a possibility. This paper presents LProtector, an automated vulnerability detection system for C/C++ codebases based on GPT-4o and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). LProtector performs binary classification to identify vulnerabilities in target codebases. To evaluate its effectiveness, we conducted experiments on the Big- Vul dataset. Results show that LProtector outperforms two state-of-the-art baselines in terms of F1 score, demonstrating the potential of integrating LLMs with vulnerability detection.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Fault Diagnosis and Localization Techniques for Power Communication Optical Cables Based on Multimodal Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low accuracy of power cable fault pattern recognition and large error of fault location, a method of power cable fault diagnosis and location based on Beluga Whale Optimization-Extreme Learning Machine (BWO-ELM) algorithm and GIS system is proposed. First, the beluga whale optimization (BWO) algorithm is used to optimize the initial parameters of the extreme learning machine (ELM), and the BWO-ELM multi classification Optical Time Domain Reflectometry (OTDR) curve analysis fault pattern recognition method is constructed, obtain the straight-line distance and type of the optical fiber fault point to lay the foundation for fault location. Secondly, the accurate positioning method of optical cable fault based on GIS is proposed, which converts the straight-line distance of the optical fiber fault point into the optical cable distance, and matches it with the actual geographical location to obtain the coordinates of the actual fault point, which are intuitively displayed in the GIS system. Finally, the application effect of the proposed method is verified by simulation experiments. The results show that the proposed method achieves a fault pattern recognition accuracy of about 98.66%, the fault location error is floating up and down 3M, and the average error is 1.481%. It has higher performance and accuracy than other recognition models and fault location methods.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning Algorithm Based on the Integration of Ant Colony Algorithm and AI Decision
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: How to plan the vehicle path efficiently and accurately is a key problem in route planning. To solve this problem, in this paper, an Algorithm combining Ant Colony Algorithm (ACA) and Proximal Policy Optimization (Proximal Policy Optimization) is proposed, PPO's new approach-Optimization-Ant Colony Policy (OACP). OACP method realizes the preliminary exploration and optimization of the path through ACA, and uses the pheromone left by ants in the search process to guide the path selection. At the same time, PPO is used for strategy learning and dynamic decision-making, and the path planning strategy is constantly adjusted through reinforcement learning mechanism, so as to ensure high planning accuracy and improve the real-time adaptability and robustness of the path. Finally, through the comparison experiment and analysis with the traditional path planning algorithm learning, the experimental results show that O-ACP method has significant advantages in improving the precision of path planning and the number of iterations. Especially in the complex road environment, O-ACP method can more accurately plan the optimal path and reduce the uncertainty in the decision-making process. This fully verifies the reliability and effectiveness of the architecture in intelligent driving path planning.

articleTitle: Research and Design of a Small Object Detection and Tracking System Based on YOLOv8 and ByteTrack Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Amidst the rapid evolution of computer vision technologies, the detection and tracking of small objects have gained paramount importance in domains such as video surveillance, autonomous driving, and intelligent transportation systems. Although existing methodologies have achieved notable advancements, enhancing the accuracy of small object detection and tracking remains a formidable challenge. This study leverages the state-of-the-art deep learning model YOLOv8 in conjunction with the multi-object tracking algorithm ByteTrack to design an efficient system for small object recognition and tracking. Through extensive and rigorous testing, we have substantiated the model's efficacy and practicality in complex environments, particularly in handling scenarios with occlusions and dynamic changes. This research not only enriches the understanding of small object tracking technologies but also furnishes robust support for real-world applications.

articleTitle: Low-Light Image Enhancement Method Based on Optimized Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a low-light image brightness restoration method based on an improved GAN network. The approach leverages CycleGAN, which does not require paired datasets, simplifying implementation. PatchGAN is used as the discriminator to capture fine-grained image details and accelerate network convergence. A brightness equalization loss function is introduced to ensure balanced brightness in the enhanced images, while a CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) is incorporated to improve feature extraction and pooling effects. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, achieving superior image enhancement in terms of both visual quality and objective metrics. Future work will explore integrating denoising modules to further enhance image quality.

articleTitle: Research on Terminal Multi-Operator Network Access and Switching Control Technology Based on 5G Power Virtual Private Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This research is intended to investigate the terminal multi - operator network access and switching control technology based on 5G power virtual private network, with an emphasis on fulfilling the stringent requirements of power business for high reliability and low latency. Firstly, this article puts forward a slice resource allocation algorithm based on game theory to optimize the switching control in multi - operator network access. The algorithm combines the dynamic allocation features of 5G slice resources to build the optimal switching strategy model for terminals between multi - operator networks. Through the design of simulation experiments, this research validates the effectiveness and stability of the proposed algorithm in terminal access selection and switching control. The simulation results indicate that under specific network load and delay situations, the algorithm can effectively decrease the delay and jitter in the switching process and enhance the utilization of network resources. In comparison with traditional methods, the average switching success rate of the algorithm in this article under different load conditions is increased by 12.5%, and the delay is decreased by 15%. This research outcome offers theoretical and technical support for efficient and reliable access to power virtual private networks, which is beneficial to the further application and promotion of 5G technology in the power industry.

Author Keywords: game theory algorithm for slice resource allocation

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection Method Based on GNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Anomaly detection is crucial in multiple fields, as it can quickly identify data errors and missing data, while traditional methods are limited by single factor identification. Faced with the complexity of big data in the digital age, especially the high-dimensional nature of time series data, traditional methods have become ineffective due to poor computational scalability and curse of dimensionality. To this end, a novel multidimensional sequence anomaly detection model based on optimized graph neural network is introduced, which adopts the graph bias network (GDN) framework as its core and innovatively integrates the optimization prediction function of Transformer model. This model significantly improves the accuracy of anomaly detection by accurately predicting the future values of adjacent time series and deeply mining the dependencies and features between data. Experimental verification shows that this method exhibits higher accuracy and computational efficiency on multiple standard datasets.

articleTitle: RFID Anti-Collision Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes an RFID tag anti-collision algorithm based on graph neural networks. RFID technology, known for its non-contact and bidirectional data communication features, is widely used in fields such as telecommunication. However, in high-density tag scenarios, the problem of tag collisions can lead to reduced system throughput and recognition efficiency. To address this issue, this paper presents the LTTE algorithm, which uses VOGT algorithm input values and applies LSTM and Transformer models for packet prediction and estimation. When the number of packets is large, Tag-Grouping technology is used to group them, improving system throughput and reducing time slot consumption. Experimental results show that compared to traditional methods, the LTTE algorithm demonstrates better adaptability in complex situations, simplifies the training process, and eliminates the need to train a neural network for each frame length, significantly enhancing RFID system performance.

articleTitle: Intelligent Management and Control of Massive Terminal Access Based on 5G Power Virtual Private Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative intelligent management scheme, which optimizes terminal access and network resource allocation through slice allocation algorithm to improve the efficiency and stability of 5G power virtual private network. In this scheme, firstly, a slice allocation algorithm that adapts to the characteristics of the power system is designed to meet the massive terminal access needs in the power system. The algorithm efficiently accomplishes the decentralized management of terminals via dynamic distribution of network resources and diminishes the risk of network congestion. Additionally., the performance of the algorithm in various terminal load and bandwidth requirement scenarios is verified through the construction of a mathematical model simulation. The simulation outcomes indicate that the proposed algorithm is better than the traditional algorithm in terminal access control and resource distribution. Particularly when the number of terminals exceeds 5.,000., the system response time is noticeably shortened., the network utilization ratio is increased by approximately 15%., and the congestion rate is decreased to 60% of the original. This method reduces the consumption of network resources while ensuring the efficient access and stable operation of power system terminals. This study not only provides an effective solution for the intelligent management of 5G power virtual private network., but also lays a technical foundation for the widespread application of smart grids in the future.

articleTitle: Fusion of Random Forest and SHAP for Distribution Transformer Fault Diagnosis Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The distribution transformer is a critical component of the power system, and its stable operation directly affects system reliability. Addressing its fault diagnosis is essential for maintaining system stability. However, current model-based diagnostic methods often lack interpretability, which hampers the in-depth understanding and accurate localization of fault causes. Thus, there is an urgent need for more efficient and interpretable fault diagnosis techniques to improve the maintenance and management of distribution transformers. To this end, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis model for distribution transformers that utilizes Random Forest and SHAP (Shapley Additive Explanations). The model incorporates current, voltage, and other circuit indicators as input features, develops a Random Forest-based fault prediction model, and employs a cost-sensitive function to address data imbalance issues. Comparative analysis with other classification algorithms (e.g., SVM, Catboost) demonstrates that the parameter-optimized Random Forest model offers superior balanced accuracy. Further, after the introduction of the cost-sensitive function, the balancing accuracy of the model achieves a significant improvement, which verifies the effectiveness of the method in dealing with unbalanced data. Additionally, this paper performs a thorough interpretability analysis of the proposed diagnostic model using the SHAP methodology, which elucidates key factors influencing distribution transformer faults by ranking feature importance. This analysis not only improves the model's transparency and credibility but also provides valuable decision support for engineers and technicians, aiding in the rapid and accurate identification of fault causes and optimization of maintenance and management strategies.

articleTitle: Classification of Aesthetic Education Groups Based on Bayesian Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper studies the application of a stochastic forest model based on Bayesian optimization in the classification of aesthetic education groups, utilizing the Kaggle dataset for empirical analysis. The dataset encompasses 12 characteristics, including students' age, gender, ethnicity, parents' education level, study duration, absenteeism, tutoring, sports, music, volunteer service, GPA, and class category, to predict class categories such as science, liberal arts, physical education, and art students. Initially, the data was screened for missing values and outliers, with 70% allocated for training and 30% for testing. Precision, Recall, and F1 Score were employed as evaluation metrics. High classification performance was achieved through Bayesian optimization of the random forest model, yielding Precision=0.88, Recall=0.81, and F1 Score=0.83. To further enhance the model's performance, a feature importance analysis within the random forest framework was conducted, resulting in the exclusion of low-correlation features and retention of only GPA, absenteeism, study duration, and age. This refinement significantly improved the model's performance, achieving Precision=0.90, Recall=0.84, and F1 Score=0.86. Finally, a comparative analysis with SVR and decision tree models revealed that the proposed model exhibited superior performance across Precision, Recall, and F1 Score, thereby validating the effectiveness and superiority of the Bayesian optimization-based random forest model for classifying aesthetic education groups.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies for Automatic Verification of SCD Files in Intelligent Substations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article proposes a multidimensional verification technique for intelligent substation SCD files based on the virtual terminal table files of all IED devices exported from SCD configuration files. The SeD files are automatically verified from four dimensions: IED naming conventions, ICD network versions, communication parameters, and virtual circuits of SCD files. This provides reliable technical support for the verification of intelligent substation SCD files and is of great significance for the stable and reliable operation of intelligent substations.

articleTitle: Research on the Error Compensation System of Automatic Calibration of Instruments Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to improve the calibration accuracy of the instrument and reduce the measurement deviation, this paper proposes a method of using deep neural network to carry out instrument calibration. This project constructs an error compensation model based on multi-layer perceptron (MLP) and convolutional neural network (CNN) to enhance the robustness and accuracy of the calibration system. In order to meet the automatic calibration requirements of multiple instruments, this system plans data preprocessing, network structure optimization and error compensation mechanism. Finally, the proposed method is verified through simulation experiments. The constructed model is trained and tested by combining random sampling and actual measurement. The simulation test shows that under various test conditions, the calibration accuracy of the system can reach 99.3%, and the calibration efficiency is 15% higher than that of conventional calibration methods. Deep neural network can effectively learn instrument error patterns and accurately compensate for various nonlinear errors, which significantly improves the accuracy and reliability of instrument automatic calibration. The research results of this project will provide a new idea and method for achieving automatic calibration of instruments and equipment, and also provide technical support for the development of intelligent instrument calibration systems in the future.

articleTitle: Fault Detection in Power Communication Networks Based on GCN-GRU
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the increasing scale and complexity of power communication networks, traditional fault diagnosis methods are inadequate for dealing with dynamic, multi-dimensional, and massive data. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a dynamic fault detection model based on a graph convolutional network (GCN) and gated recurrent unit (GRU). By modeling devices in the power communication network as graph structures and combining GCN to extract spatial features of the network topology with GRU to capture dynamic characteristics in the time dimension, accurate fault diagnosis can be achieved. First, event codes and association matrices are constructed by encoding the fault types of power communication devices, allowing the visualization of connections between devices and fault patterns. Then, GCN is used for frequency and spectral domain feature extraction, combined with time series modeling using GRU to capture the spatial and temporal correlation of faults. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms traditional methods in terms of accuracy and efficiency, providing a new approach for the intelligent maintenance of power communication networks.

articleTitle: Robustness Optimization of Image Classification Model Based on Adversarial Training
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As an important part of artificial intelligence, deep neural networks have been widely used in various fields, and show superior performance in image classification tasks. However, with the improvement of the performance of deep learning image classification models, these high-precision models are vulnerable to security threats against samples, resulting in misjudgments in the models, which threatens the robustness of artificial intelligence systems. In the image classification task, the adversarial robustness of the model is promoted mainly through the iteration of adversarial training methods, but the existing adversarial samples are quite different from human perception, and the defense has certain limitations. Therefore, this paper studies the robustness optimization of image classification model based on adversarial training, and further improves the robustness of the classification model from the perspective of adversarial attack and defense. Starting with neural networks and image classification, AT -AMP, an improved adversarial training algorithm based on the weight parameters of the smooth model, improves the robust generalization gap and robust overfitting problems of the native adversarial training AT by searching for the smoothing minimum of the model weight loss, and achieves better adversarial robustness based on the comparison of different data sets and different models. The accuracy of image classification is further improved.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Intelligent Jet Fire Extinguishing System Based on STM32 and Image Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, the most widely used large-space automatic jet fire extinguishing system-LRB-automatic fire water cannon) is easily disturbed by sunlight in outdoor environment, resulting in accidental spray or unable to find the fire source. To address these issues, the proposed system integrates ultraviolet (UV) sensors and image recognition technology to accurately detect and extinguish flames, both indoors and outdoors, at a lower cost. The system is divided into multiple modules, including image processing, main control, mobile robot base, and power management. The camera filters visible light interference using a narrow-band filter, while the UV sensor detects open flames, enabling accurate tracking. The water cannon is mounted on a mobile robot, which can autonomously adjust its position to enhance fire-fighting efficiency. The paper highlights the modular design, allowing for easy upgrades without affecting other components. Additionally, the system can be expanded to include automatic patrol capabilities and remote monitoring for broader fire coverage in large spaces.

articleTitle: A Grid-Based Random Erasing Approach for Enhanced Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In modern image classification tasks, the data is insufficient due to time or money cost constraints, which affects the generalization and accuracy of the model. This paper proposes a random erasure method based on gridded images, aiming to expand the dataset to improve the generalization ability and classification accuracy of the model while reducing the damage to the original structure of the image caused by continuous erasure. This paper uses YOLOv8n-cls, YOLOv8m-cls, and ResNet50 as models and selects CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, FER2013, and mini-ImageNet as datasets for comparative experiments. The Top-1 accuracy, Top-5 accuracy, and loss function curves on the validation set are used to analyze the effect of random erasing on each model's performance on various datasets. The findings demonstrate that lightweight models greatly increase accuracy on simple datasets like CIFAR-10. However, to effectively use the enhancing effect of random erasing on complicated datasets, more sophisticated models are required. This study shows the impact of random erasing based on gridded images on improving the generalization ability and classification accuracy of the model in image classification tasks. It points out the limitations of this method and potential future optimization directions to better handle more complex classification tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Efficiency and Security Balance of Federated Learning Algorithm for Multi-node Privacy Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to solve the key problem of improving algorithm efficiency while ensuring data security, this paper introduces an innovative method, the cryptographic-Homomorphic Asynchronous (EHA) method, which combines homomorphic encryption (HE) with asynchronous federation learning (AFL). EHA method uses HE to realize the encrypted transmission and calculation of data, ensuring the confidentiality of data in the whole process and preventing information leakage. At the same time, AFL is used for asynchronous model update, allowing nodes to update model parameters at different time points according to their own conditions, effectively reducing the delay caused by synchronous waiting, and significantly improving the efficiency and response ability of federation learning. Finally, by comparing with the traditional federated learning algorithm, experiments and analysis of experimental results show that compared with the traditional methods, EHA has significant advantages in communication efficiency, confusion matrix optimization and system robustness enhancement. Especially in the multi-node environment, EHA method not only effectively balances the relationship between efficiency and security, but also significantly reduces the communication delay and computing cost, and significantly improves the overall performance of the system. These results fully verify the feasibility and effectiveness of EHA architecture in the federated learning domain of multi-node privacy protection.

articleTitle: Enhanced Yolov4 Power Equipment Surface Detection Method Based on Deep Residual Network and Collaborative Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The existing technology still lacks effective means to detect electrical characteristic problems, such as icing, corrosion, oil leakage, cracks, dirt, and other electrical characteristic defects. How to accurately detect internal defects of electrical equipment with uneven appearance under high voltage conditions where the characteristics and morphological changes are not obvious is a topic worthy of research. This article investigates a method for detecting infrared image defects in power equipment using YOLOv4 (You Only Look Once, Version 4) algorithm. Our goal is to improve the automation detection capability of power equipment and ensure the safe operation of the power grid. We use CSPDarkNet53 (Cross Stage Partial Network DarkNet53) as the basic backbone network and combine it with CA (Coordinated Attention) attention mechanism to improve the model's attention to key features. This experiment used an infrared image dataset from real power equipment inspections, including five types of defects: ice, rust, oil leakage, cracking, and dirt. The model was trained and evaluated by adjusting the learning rate, batch size, and data augmentation strategy. The experimental results showed that the configuration with a learning rate of 0.001, batch size of 16, and data augmentation achieved the best performance, with an accuracy of 98.5%, a recall rate of 97.2%, an F1 score of 97.8%, and an average detection time of 0.045 seconds. The method explored in this article achieves efficient and accurate detection of defects in power equipment in complex environments, providing an effective solution for automatic detection of power systems.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Data Format Conversion and Compatibility Guarantee in Technical Platforms for Cross Platform Application Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of information technology, cross platform application integration is facing issues such as inconsistent data formats and compatibility, while data security issues are becoming increasingly prominent. In addition, due to the explosive growth of data scale, the demand for real-time processing is also increasing. Therefore, how to improve the computing speed of the system is an urgent problem that needs to be solved. In the field of computer science, the above problems mainly manifest in issues such as data flow, consistency, and security across multiple computing environments. This article studies a method for data format conversion and compatibility assurance based on a technology middleware, which integrates multi-source data through the technology middleware to ensure data integrity and consistency. At the same time, a secure sharing mechanism is provided to ensure the circulation and use of data between different users and platforms. The platform will also support more programming and optimize the data processing process, thereby improving the system's processing speed. The study found that this method exhibits superior performance in terms of data conversion speed, system response time, CPU and memory utilization efficiency. Especially in terms of data accuracy, this method achieves 98% and 99% accuracy in handling JSON and SQL Database data, respectively. In terms of security, the data encryption score is as high as 95.6. The method applied in this article effectively solves the format conversion and compatibility issues in cross platform data exchange, while strengthening data security and improving the overall performance of the system.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Genetic Algorithm in Parameter Identification of Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A new generation of 300Mvar synchronous condenser is widely used in UHVDC transmission system., but its transient operation parameters need to be further studied and analyzed. In order to obtain the accurate motor model and parameters., this paper proposes an improved genetic algorithm., which improves the population initialization., crossover and mutation operation on the basis of introducing elite retention strategy. This method effectively avoids the traditional genetic algorithm falling into the local optimal problem. Finally., the advantages., stability and accuracy of the improved genetic algorithm and the necessity of parameter identification are verified by the actual operation data.

articleTitle: Data Security Protection Technology for Power Terminal Devices Based on Security Chips
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper addresses the communication security protection issue between edge-layer devices and the master station in digital power grids. A secure communication module based on the national cryptography standards (GM standards) IPSec VPN is designed for edge-layer devices. This module enables communication between edge devices and the master station, filters terminal data, and processes the data according to predefined policies, preventing unauthorized data from entering the tunnel. It effectively reduces the risk of attacks on the master station network.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent System of Complex Structured Light Three-Dimensional Measurement Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This system integrates complex structured light projection and machine vision imaging technology to achieve efficient and accurate measurement of three-dimensional structures. In order to deal with the high computational load and error problems of traditional methods in data processing, this paper designs an image processing solution based on compressed sensing algorithm. By means of compressed sensing technology, the quantity of data is effectively decreased during the process of image collection and data reconstruction, thus remarkably lessening the computational load. This approach not only streamlines the data-processing procedure but also enhances the measurement precision of the system on complex surfaces, allowing the system to attain a better equilibrium between real-time performance and accuracy. To confirm the performance and superiority of the algorithm, this paper builds multiple test models in a simulation environment and comprehensively assesses the impact of the compressed sensing algorithm by contrasting the measurement results under different structured light modes. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that in comparison with the traditional method, the proposed algorithm exhibits remarkable advantages in handling complex curved surfaces and unevenly reflecting surfaces. It can keep low inaccuracies while guaranteeing high precision and has strong sturdiness against external interference. Specific data show that the measurement error of the system under complex surface conditions is controlled within 0.05 mm, meeting the needs of high-precision measurement.

articleTitle: Research on Wall Crack Recognition Algorithm Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to overcome the low efficiency of digital image processing, this paper introduces DNN to detect wall cracks. By constructing the training data set of deep learning model, the method of test image acquisition and preprocessing is studied, and the test image library of crack detection model is established. The crack open data set is used to improve the crack training. The deep learning target detection algorithm was studied, and the wall crack recognition and positioning model based on YOLOv8 algorithm was constructed. The width, depth parameters and boundary frame loss function of YOLOv8 algorithm were optimized and adjusted by using the crack recognition data set. It effectively reduces the risk and cost of detection work, and has a strong engineering application prospect and social value.

articleTitle: Design of Tunable Laser Drive and Temperature Control System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on the operational principles of field-programmable gate arrays (FPGA) and laser diodes, we have designed and constructed a semiconductor laser driver circuit. The temperature control and feedback circuit employ high-speed MOSFETs as switching devices to drive the laser diodes. Utilizing LTspice simulation software, we analyzed the impact of supply voltage, energy storage capacitor, and damping resistor on the driving pulse in the laser driver circuit, ultimately selecting optimal circuit parameters. This circuit meets the design requirements for high-current nanosecond pulse semiconductor laser driver circuits. Through interaction with an upper computer system, it is possible to continuously adjust the laser's drive current and operating temperature to ensure that the output wavelength of the semiconductor laser falls within an optimal range. Following testing, this temperature-controlled semiconductor laser driver system fully satisfies practical application needs and effectively resolves issues related to unstable wavelength and power caused by fluctuations in the working temperature of the semiconductor laser.

articleTitle: Leveraging Librosa for Speech Emotion Recognition: Techniques and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Speech emotion recognition (SER), as an important research direction in the field of affective computing, aims to identify and classify emotional states from speech data. In this study, MLP Classifier model was used to classify RAVDESS data set, and the model was trained by extracting audio features such as Mel frequency cepstral coefficient (MFCC), chroma feature and Mell spectrum. The experimental results show that the overall accuracy of the model on this dataset reaches 78.12%. In particular, in the recognition of “calm” emotions, the model performed particularly well, with a recall rate of 82% and an F1 score of 0.87.

articleTitle: A Micro-Doppler Analysis for Radar-Based UAV Swarm Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) manufacturing and cluster control technology, UAV swarms have gradually penetrated the civil and military fields, and their large-scale application has put forward new requirements for the detection technology of UAV clusters. As the radar cross-section of a single UAV is usually small, time-frequency features are usually applied to radar-based UAV detections. In this paper, a method is proposed to utilize the micro-Doppler information generated by the mutual motion of UAVs within a UAV swarm for the determination of UAV clusters and single UAVs. By receiving the echoes generated by the UAV swarm and obtaining the time-frequency map after matched filtering and Short Time Fourier Transformation (STFT) in the corresponding slow time dimension, the micro-Doppler effect generated by the micro-motion inside the UAV swarm can be extracted. Finally, the feasibility of this method is verified by signal simulation on the echoes of UAV swarms.

articleTitle: Applying Recurrent Neural Networks to Time-Series Analysis in Big Data for Decision Support
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The burgeoning field of big data has necessitated advanced analytical techniques capable of extracting valuable insights from complex time-series datasets. This research explores the application of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN s), specifically Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models, in the context of time-series analysis for enhancing decision support systems. The study begins with a comprehensive literature review, examining the evolution of time-series analysis and the integration of deep learning methodologies. A theoretical framework is established, detailing the mathematical principles of time-series and the architecture of LSTM networks, followed by a methodological approach to model training and validation. Preliminary results are presented through insightful visualizations, showcasing the predictive capabilities of the RNN models against traditional forecasting methods. The paper delves into an advanced data analysis phase, assessing model performance across various metrics and datasets. The discussion section synthesizes the findings, evaluating the effectiveness of RNN s in decision support and contemplating future research avenues. The paper concludes by highlighting the transformative potential of deep learning in business analytics and strategic decision-making.

articleTitle: Research on Automobile Intelligent Manufacturing Defect Detection Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This research puts forward a deep-learning-centered automotive manufacturing defect detection algorithm. It utilizes the SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detector) algorithm to realize the efficient detection of surface flaws on automotive components. Initially, the system employs CNN to extract image features and combines multi-scale features for the purpose of strengthening the recognition capability of diverse defects. Subsequently, the model incorporates automatic tagging and data augmentation techniques to enhance the generalization ability of the model with respect to different defect types. This research has designed a range of experimental scenarios and has verified the effectiveness of the algorithm through accurate data analysis. The experimental outcomes indicate that the proposed algorithm has attained a high level in terms of accuracy, recall rate and other metrics. In comparison with traditional detection methods, it exhibits greater robustness and real-time performance. Precisely, in the actual test set, the algorithm has achieved a detection accuracy of 95.6% and a recall rate of 92.8%, which has effectively enhanced the detection efficiency and decreased the false detection rate. The research findings demonstrate that the defect detection algorithm based on deep learning has extensive application prospects in the automotive intelligent manufacturing field, and is anticipated to significantly boost the automation level of the manufacturing process and the reliability of product quality.

articleTitle: Bistatic SAR Imaging with NLFM Range Migration Algorithm and Chirp Polarity Modulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper presents a range migration algorithm (RMA) for bistatic synthetic aperture radar (SAR) based on nonlinear frequency modulation (NLFM) with polarity agility in frequency coefficient modulation. Traditional SAR imaging techniques typically employ linear frequency modulation (LFM) signals, but these methods often lack sufficient anti-jamming capabilities in complex environments, particularly under delayed retransmission interference. To mitigate this limitation, polarity-agile frequency coefficient modulation is applied, utilizing the nonlinear properties of NLFM signals to improve interference suppression and imaging accuracy. Results from multiple point target imaging experiments and delayed interference simulations confirm that the proposed algorithm distinguishes effectively between interference and true echo signals, significantly enhancing imaging reliability and anti-jamming robustness. In high-interference environments, the algorithm effectively suppresses false targets, greatly improving imaging precision. This approach offers an innovative and practical solution for bistatic SAR imaging in complex scenarios characterized by delayed retransmission interference.

articleTitle: Research and Application Analysis of Visual SLAM Algorithm Integrated with YOLOv5 in Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The paper presents a visual simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system enhanced by integrating YOLOv5 for dynamic environments. Traditional visual SLAM systems often struggle with positioning accuracy and robustness when dynamic objects are present, as these systems typically rely on static feature points. The proposed method leverages YOLOv5 for object detection to identify and classify dynamic elements, such as people and vehicles, and eliminates their feature points, thereby reducing the influence of dynamic objects on the SLAM system. The integration is achieved by modifying the ORB-SLAM3 framework, specifically enhancing its tracking thread with YOLOv5's dynamic feature point elimination. Experimental validation on the TUM dataset demonstrates a significant improvement in attitude estimation accuracy, particularly in highly dynamic scenarios, with performance enhancements exceeding 90% compared to traditional methods. The results highlight the enhanced adaptability and robustness of the improved SLAM system in complex environments, addressing the challenges posed by dynamic objects and optimizing its utility for applications in indoor positioning, autonomous driving, and mobile robotics.

articleTitle: Adaptive Scene Change Safety Helmet Wearing Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Wearing a safety helmet is a basic measure to reduce or avoid accident losses. However, factors such as changes in lighting and target occlusion can cause instability in various test result indicators. To address this issue, a helmet-wearing detection algorithm based on adaptive scene changes is proposed.
