Taking YOLOv8n as the baseline, the SE attention mechanism is embedded in the basic unit C2f to adjust channel weights, capturing more details and enhancing the ability for multi-scale feature extraction and fusion. The BiFormer attention mechanism is embedded at the front end of the detection head, utilizing dual-layer routing attention to improve target feature capture, enhance detection head performance, and strengthen the algorithm's adaptive scene change capability. The baseline algorithm's loss function, CIoU, is replaced with Inner IoU, focusing more on overlapping areas within the bounding box. This improves detection accuracy, accelerates convergence, and enhances generalization ability. Additionally, the Lion optimizer is used to optimize the algorithm, improving gradient descent performance, reducing memory consumption and computational complexity, and increasing detection speed. Ablation experiments and comparative experiments on the self-made Adaptive Scene dataset show that, compared with the baseline algorithm, Precision, Recall, and mAP are improved by 3.1%, 5.3%, and 4.4 %, respectively, demonstrating the superiority of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Graph Network Social Recommendation Algorithm Based on AGRU-GNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the widespread use of social network data, how to effectively utilize social relationships in recommendation systems has become a hot research topic. This paper proposes a graph network social recommendation algorithm based on the combination of Adaptive Gated Recurrent Unit (AGRU) and Graph Neural Network (GNN), called AGRU-GNN. The algorithm models users' historical behavior sequences through AGRU and models users' social relationships through GNN, achieving joint learning of social information and user behavior. Experimental results show that AGRU-GNN outperforms traditional recommendation algorithms in multiple real-world datasets, especially in scenarios with strong social influence. This research provides new insights for further optimization of social recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Abnormal of Shore-Ship VoIP Call Forwarding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper aims at the issue of call forwarding voice communication in the inter shore ship soft-switch system. Through analysis of signaling data, it was found that the cause of the problem was that the transmission channel mechanism was not supported when there was a change in media resources during the implementation of the soft-switch system's business functions, resulting in abnormal voice communication. Starting from the characteristics of SIP protocol interaction, the mechanism of the problem was analyzed. By changing the transmission channel mechanism to adapt to the media resource changes in the soft-switch system, the problem was effectively solved, thereby ensuring the communication quality of shore ship telephone services.

articleTitle: Research on Image Encryption Algorithm Based on Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of the internet, social software and media have become ubiquitous, making images increasingly important in daily life. The dissemination of a large number of images on social networks has made information security issues increasingly prominent, and image encryption technology has become increasingly important. This article mainly studies image encryption algorithms based on chaotic systems. Firstly, the background and history of image encryption were introduced, followed by an explanation of the basic concepts based on chaotic systems. Then, several chaos based image encryption schemes were comprehensively compared, and their advantages and disadvantages were analyzed. Subsequently, several common measures for evaluating the effectiveness of encryption schemes were introduced. Finally, the future development of image encryption algorithms based on chaotic systems is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Network Optimization and Reliability Enhancement Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of computer networks, it has become an inevitable trend for people to pursue the stability and reliability of computer networks in the process of operation, and effective design optimization of computer networks needs to be carried out in the process of operation. In view of this situation, on the basis of analyzing the existing computer network design schemes, this paper improves the reproduction mode of the traditional genetic algorithm. Combined with the established new computer network reliability optimization model, while ensuring the global convergence, the fluency of the algorithm is improved. And finally the experimental and simulation are used to effectively verify that the improved genetic algorithm can further optimize the computer network, so that the reliability of the computer network can be greatly improved.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low-Power Wireless Sensor Network in Smart Home System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a low-power wireless sensor network for smart home systems, based on the Internet of Things (IoT). The proposed architecture is divided into three layers: the sensor layer, coordination layer, and receiving layer. The sensor layer consists of various ZigBee-based sensor nodes, while the coordination layer includes a ZigBee coordinator and a home gateway to relay data to the Internet. The receiving layer provides users with access to sensor data through multiple devices, such as PCs and smartphones. We adopted a star-type ZigBee network topology to simplify the network structure, reduce cost, and meet the demands of small-to-medium-sized smart home environments. The CC2430 chip was selected for sensor nodes due to its low cost, low energy consumption, and integrated capabilities, making it well-suited for IoT applications. Experimental results demonstrated effective communication, low latency, and reliable data transmission within the smart home setup.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Active Distribution Network True Test Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the context of the construction of new power systems, there is an urgent need for true testing and verification of new fault self-healing algorithms for active distribution networks with a large number of distributed photovoltaics connected in order to ensure their safe and reliable operation after being connected to the network. This paper proposes a real test platform for active distribution networks and establishes a 10kV distribution network real test environment consisting of a real primary system, a scene simulation system, a measurement and control system, and a test scene management system. The authenticity and practicality of the simulated environment of the active distribution network real test platform were verified through on-site single-phase grounding fault testing application.

articleTitle: Optimization Study of Microgrid Energy Storage System Based on Particle Swarm Algorithm and Whale Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, the development and utilization of renewable energy has become an important way to solve the global energy crisis and environmental pollution problems. This paper investigates the configuration of microgrids in parks, aiming to improve the utilization efficiency of renewable energy and the economy of power supply. Firstly, this paper analyzes in detail the key factors of the economic efficiency of the coordinated and optimized configuration scheme of wind and solar energy storage under the two modes of independent and joint operation of different park micro grids. Secondly, on the basis of the analyzed results, the optimal energy storage allocation scheme formulation model is constructed using particle swarm algorithm and whale algorithm respectively. Finally, the model is brought into different configuration scheme solving, and the result visualization of the final results proves the superiority of the model.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of an Interactive Language Learning Platform Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This study designed and implemented an efficient language learning platform. The platform combines interactive teaching and artificial intelligence technology to improve learners' language expression ability through text generation and dialogue system. The core algorithm of the platform is based on the Transformer model, which performs well in natural language processing tasks, especially in machine translation, dialogue generation and other fields. Through the improved self-attention mechanism and decoding structure, the platform can generate high-quality text dialogue content to meet the learning needs of users. In addition, this paper conducted a large number of experiments in model training and simulation testing to ensure the stability and accuracy of the system. The simulation results show that the performance of the platform in multilingual dialogue generation tasks is better than that of traditional language learning systems, and the generated text has significant improvements in grammatical accuracy and language fluency. Through quantitative data analysis, the platform achieved a dialogue generation accuracy of 92.5%, while the average satisfaction of users' interactive experience was 87.3%. This study demonstrates the feasibility and prospects of building an interactive language learning platform based on artificial intelligence technology, which can provide new solutions for future language teaching.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection of Logistics Packages Based on CNN and Image Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To address abnormal situations such as packaging damage, liquid leakage, and item displacement during logistics package transportation, this paper introduces Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and image recognition technology to achieve real-time anomaly detection and alarm, improving the response speed and accuracy of the logistics system. First, by designing multiple layers of convolution and pooling layers, adding Batch Normalization layers and Dropout layers to prevent overfitting, a CNN deep learning model suitable for logistics package anomaly detection is constructed. Key features are extracted through image preprocessing methods such as normalization and data enhancement to ensure that the model has high recognition adaptability to various abnormal situations such as damage and leakage. Secondly, through data enhancement methods such as rotation, scaling, brightness adjustment, and transfer learning using pre-trained models, the model's adaptability in different lighting, angles, and occlusion conditions is improved. Finally, the model is applied to actual monitoring, and real-time alarms are issued for abnormalities such as damage and leakage, which are then fed back to the system closed-loop management. This method is significantly better than traditional methods in terms of detection accuracy and response speed. Under natural light environment, the model detection accuracy is as high as 98.4%, reducing false positives and false negatives. Combining CNN's anomaly detection technology effectively improves the accuracy and efficiency of logistics monitoring and provides technical support for intelligent logistics management.

articleTitle: A Novel Self-Attentive Neural Network Hardware Accelerator for Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: High-precision floating-point self-attentive neural networks have high computational complexity and power consumption, posing significant challenges for deployment on edge devices. To tackle these problems, this paper propose a novel deep neural network hardware accelerator with unique vector tiling systolic array and vector ALU designs, where vector tiling systolic array is used to accelerate matrix multiplications, and vector ALU is used to process non-linear operations. By utilizing a systolic array with a systolic pipeline data path, matrix multiplication is accelerated. The vector tiling mechanism ensures that output results are immediately fed back into the arrays for further accumulation, without additional memory access or data loading delays. This approach significantly reduces arithmetic cycle overhead. Extensive experiments show that our method achieve 70×, 160 ×, 6 × and 9 × increase on peak energy efficiency ratio from Intel i3-2320 CPU, Intel i5-9400 CPU, RTX 2060 GPU and RTX 3060 GPU, respectively. The peak arthmetic of hardware accelerator is 2.41 TOPs in 8-bit fixed-point computation.

articleTitle: Temporal Neural Network Intervention Detection and Response Strategies in Anti-Interference Satellite Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Communication signals are easily affected by various interference factors during transmission, which often poses a threat to the performance and stability of satellite communication systems. To address this issue, this paper investigates the anti-interference detection and response strategies of satellite communication systems using temporal neural networks. This article studies common types of interference in satellite communication systems and develops an interference detection model using a temporal neural network. The model is used to model the signal in a temporal manner, and the powerful learning ability of the algorithm is utilized to achieve automatic interference detection. Corresponding response strategies can be designed based on the results of interference detection. The experimental results show that six types of signal interference were extracted, and the average accuracy of detecting these six types of interference in this paper is 94.04%. The use of temporal neural networks for anti-interference research in satellite communication systems can identify and analyze various interference signals, improve the system's anti-interference ability and stability.

articleTitle: Research on Resolution of SDM Algorithm for Inverse Scattering Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, the resolution of inverse scattering imaging based on the supervised descent method (SDM) is studied. The simulation model is mainly composed of eight half-wave dipole antennas. There is a cylindrical radiating boundary on the periphery of the eight antennas, and the imaging area is surrounded in the middle of the antenna, in which two small balls are placed as target objects. The resolution of inverse scattering imaging in this case is studied based on SDM algorithm by simulating the parameters of ball size, background conductivity and background permittivity. The preliminary results show that the resolution of inverse scattering imaging is affected by the size of the ball, the background conductivity and the background permittivity.

articleTitle: Realization of Fully Digital Parameter-Variable N-Ary CPFSK Modulation System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: CPFSK plays an important role in modern wireless communication and digital transmission system because of its strong anti-interference ability, high spectral efficiency and low power consumption. In order to adapt to different application scenarios, an FPGA-based variable CPFSK modulation system is introduced in this paper. The system parameters of the modulator such as code rate, carrier frequency, modulation index and frequency offset are controlled by the upper computer software in real time to realize the CPFSK modulation function with flexible parameter configuration, which has a good application prospect. This method has been applied to engineering practice, and the system runs stably and has good performance.

articleTitle: ALOHA Improvement Algorithm for Dynamic Frame Time Slots with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is a radio-based communication technology used to collect and identify data from tagged objects. In recent years, RFID technology has been widely applied in both industrial and daily life, driving a continuous increase in the demand for tag reading systems. In large-scale tag environments, RFID systems often encounter collisions due to simultaneous tag responses, which results in severe collisions within the same reading frame and decreases reading efficiency. The key to solving this issue lies in improving the speed and accuracy of the tag number estimation algorithm. This paper presents a novel tag number estimation algorithm that combines the Dynamic Framed Slotted ALOHA (DFSA) algorithm with Transformer and LSTM neural networks. Compared to traditional algorithms, this approach ensures more accurate tag number predictions, reduces the time consumption of the reading system, and enhances system throughput. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm significantly improves the recognition accuracy of RFID systems while minimizing slot wastage.

articleTitle: Research on Multivariable Coordinated Predictive Control Algorithm Based on Air Conditioning Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In view of the significant hysteresis, nonlinearity, and time-varying characteristics of traditional air-conditioning systems, intelligent air-conditioning systems are evolving towards enhanced controllability, multifunctionality, and reduced power consumption. This paper proposes a multivariable coordinated predictive control algorithm applied to air-conditioning controller systems. The algorithm's principles are analyzed by examining input variables and set temperatures, such as temperature, humidity, electrical parameters of air conditioning operation, flammable gas concentration in the environment, ionic smoke detection status, and personnel mobility. Output variables such as humidity and its deviation are also analyzed, and the design steps of the multivariable coordinated predictive control algorithm applied to the PC server software of the air-conditioning system are presented. Finally, a comparative test of temperature and humidity control was conducted on a single Midea air conditioner. The results indicate that the multivariable coordinated predictive control algorithm is well-suited for air-conditioning control systems, particularly in the most economical temperature control mode. Compared to the system's performance before the algorithm's implementation, the control is optimized, resulting in a 19.4% energy saving.

articleTitle: Prediction of Output Power of PV Power Stations Based on Particle Swarm Optimization-Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The photovoltaic (PV) power output exists uncertainty andvolatility due to external factors, so that the accurate prediction of its output power plays an important role in power scheduling and balance between supply and demand. To solve this problem, our prediction model was established based on the power characteristics of two PV power stations in a place for analysis. Firstly, the data set was pretreated and visualized in order to observe the data characteristics. Secondly, in order to optimize the performance of the model, the prediction model of Random Forest optimized by Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO-RF) was established, and the two parameters of decision tree number and split feature number of Random Forest were optimized. Finally, the cross-validation method was used to check and avoid the overfitting of the model, so that the generalization ability was also improved. The experimental results show that the average prediction accuracy of the model is higher than 94%, which has high prediction accuracy and practicability for the general PV power forecasting.

articleTitle: Phase Error Measurement and Compensation Technology for Demodulated Signals Based on Phase Synchronization Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on the phase synchronization, the phase error of demodulated signal is detected and compensated. At present, research on this issue mainly focuses on the low measurement accuracy of phase error and the poor compensation effect for phase error. To solve this problem, this article adopted a new phase synchronization algorithm. Firstly, a new phase synchronization method was adopted to improve the measurement accuracy. On this basis, the advanced phase detection method was adopted to effectively reduce the noise, distortion and other interference in the system, thus improving the accuracy and stability of the system. Secondly, phase synchronization technology and precise phase compensation method were used to compensate phase deviation of demodulated signal. The quality and reliability of demodulated signal were improved by the correction of complex phase distortion. The qualification rate of this article could reach 96.9%. The research in this article is of great significance for improving the phase synchronization and demodulation performance in communication systems.

articleTitle: Research on Multidimensional Anomalous Behavior Baseline Characterization Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In response to the stealth and difficulty in detecting the characteristics of Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) attacks, as well as the blind spots in internal network supervision, this paper proposes a multidimensional anomalous behavior baseline characterization technique based on deep learning. This technique integrates the frequency, time, business, and other multidimensional attributes of terminal behavior and network behavior, achieving comprehensive profiling and adaptive correlation analysis, and constructing a user network behavior baseline security model. By comparing the differences between current behavior and the baseline model, the model can assist security management personnel in prompt detection of abnormal behaviors that do not meet the security baseline requirements, thereby strengthening the security management personnel's capability to proactively identify and swiftly respond to emerging threats.

articleTitle: The Separated Channel Simultaneous Wireless Power and Data Transmission System Based on Double-Layer Orthogonal DD Coils
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In response to the issue of increased cross-coupling between data transmission coils and power transmission coils due to misalignment in the separated channel simultaneous wireless power and data transmission system, which leads to the increase of crosstalk in the system data transmission loop, this paper proposes a method of using double-layer orthogonal DD coils as the data transmission coils, and realizing the insertion and removal of DD coils by the switch, and using the decoupling characteristics between the DD coil and the square coil and the series and anti-series DD coils to offset the crosstalk to reduce the crosstalk in the data transmission channel. This approach ensures that the date transmission coils exhibit robust anti-offset properties within a defined quadrant region. Through simulation, it is validated that the system is capable of reducing the crosstalk in the data transmission channel by series or anti-series connection of DD coils. The simulations demonstrate stable data transmission under conditions of 5 cm misalignment in the x-axis and y-axis directions of the secondary side coupling mechanism, at a power level of 6 kW.

Author Keywords: Simultaneous Wireless Power and Data Transmission

articleTitle: Bi-Directional Wireless Charging System Design Based on Three-Level T-Type
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to solve the grid-connected demand of bi-directional wireless charging system and reduce the grid-side harmonic pollution when the Bi-directional wireless charging system is connected to the grid, a device structure combining the three-level T-type with the Bi-directional wireless charging system is proposed, and the three-level T-type AC-DC converter is used in the bi-directional wireless charging system, replacing the traditional two-level bi-directional converter. The three-level T-type has the advantages of small output harmonics and large power factor, and the combination of the three-level T-type with the bi-directional wireless charging system can better realize the forward and reverse transmissions. The combination of three-level T-type and bi-directional wireless charging system can better realize the forward and reverse transmission. Based on the grid-side three-level T-type bi-directional converter, the circuit structure, working principle, and key parameters design of the three-level T-type bi-directional converter are described. Finally, MATLAB/simulink is used to simulate and analyze the joint system, and the THD of the grid-side current is 1.13% and 2.24% when the grid is charging to the battery as well as the battery is feeding back to the grid, respectively. The simulation verifies the feasibility of the three-level T-type and bi-directional wireless energy transmission system and the correctness of the parameter design.

articleTitle: A Geometric Constellation Shaping Optimization Method Based on the Sparrow Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A geometric constellation shaping optimization method based on the sparrow search algorithm is proposed. This method employs the bit error rate as the fitness function as well as utilizes the sparrow search mechanism to adjust the positions of the constellation points, achieving the optimal distribution after several iterations. Simulation results indicate that the sparrow-optimized constellation provides a greater optical signal-to-noise ratio gain compared to the uniform quadrature amplitude modulation constellation. Furthermore, the sparrow-optimized geometric shaping constellation enables longer transmission distances in the coherent optical communication system compared to the uniform constellation. Therefore, the proposed scheme has certain development prospects in long-distance, high-speed optical fiber communication.

articleTitle: Efficient Neural Network Design for Radar Signal Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an innovative approach to the problem of radar signal recognition, which is based on Neural Architecture Search (NAS). With the development of radar technology, radar signals become more and more diverse and complex, which brings great challenges to the traditional signal processing methods. Therefore, this paper aims to explore a more efficient and intelligent radar signal recognition scheme. The core contribution of this paper is the introduction of NAS technology to radar signal recognition. Unlike traditional deep learning-based methods that require manual design of the network structure, our approach automatically finds the optimal neural network structure through a pre-defined search space and search strategy. This method not only greatly reduces the time and effort required by the researchers to design the network structure, but also guarantees the performance superiority of the network model. Specifically, by automating the search process, we can find network architectures that are better suited to handling specific types of radar signals, thus improving the accuracy and efficiency of identification. To assess the validity of our proposed method, we undertook extensive experimentation across various standard datasets. The results of these experiments indicate that, in comparison to several existing sophisticated methods, our method has enhanced recognition accuracy, particularly in the handling of intricate and variable radar signals.

articleTitle: A Study on a Linear-Frequency-Modulation Interference Detection Algorithm for Single-Antenna Low-Earth-Orbit Signal-of-Opportunity Positioning Receivers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Signal-of-Opportunity (SOP) positioning based on Low-Earth-Orbit (LEO) constellation has become a research hotspot. Because of its large quantity, wide spectrum coverage and strong signal power, LEO satellite SOP signal has strong anti-jamming ability. However, there is still little research on anti-jamming technology for LEO satellite SOP signal positioning, especially for LFM interference. At present, it has not been deeply studied at home and abroad. Because of the great difference between the downlink signal of LEO satellite and the signal of Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) based on medium and high orbit, the research results of anti-jamming of traditional satellite guidance system can not be directly applied. In this paper, a Wigner-Ville distribution interference detection algorithm based on iterative signal cancellation (WVD-SIC) is proposed for LEO constellation signal with narrow downlink bandwidth and high landing signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). The algorithm eliminates the influence of strong signal power in input signal on Linear Frequency Modulation (LFM) interference detection by iterative fitting, and determines the characteristics of LFM interference signal by least square fitting. Finally, the improved performance of the algorithm is verified by simulation. The results show that compared with traditional algorithms, this method can effectively eliminate single/multi-component LFM interference, and improve the anti-jamming performance of LFM significantly in LEO satellite anti-jamming scene.

articleTitle: Research on Multimodal Biometric Computer-Assisted Identification System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper puts forward a multimodal biometric recognition system founded on deep learning. Through integrating various biometric data like fingerprints, faces, and irises, the precision and sturdiness of recognition are observably enhanced. The method of combining CNN and LSTM is used to fully explore the feature interaction relationship of different modal data. In the process of model training, this paper introduces an adaptive weighted loss function to dynamically adjust the influence weights of different modal features, thereby enhancing the stability and anti-interference ability of recognition. This system is tested using a public data set containing many multimodal biometric features and compared with traditional recognition methods. The results show that the system has achieved significant improvements in both recognition accuracy and response speed. Specifically, the system achieved an accuracy rate of 98.7% under the fusion of different modalities, which is about 12.5% higher than that of a single modality. In addition, this system also shows higher robustness when processing noisy data, and the recognition error rate is reduced to 2.3%.

articleTitle: Research on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) Trajectory Based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Wolf Pack Algorithm (WPA)
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of drone technology, the application domains for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have expanded significantly. In practical applications, effective trajectory planning enhances the operational efficiency and safety of UAVs. This paper primarily investigated the application of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Wolf Pack Algorithm (WPA) in UAV trajectory planning to address the path planning challenges faced by drones in complex environments. Firstly, the fundamental principles of the PSO algorithm and its adaptability in UAV path planning were analyzed. Secondly, the WPA was introduced, exploring how the social hierarchy and cooperative hunting behaviors of wolves could be leveraged to effectively resolve path planning issues. Finally, simulations were conducted using MATLAB to evaluate the performance of both algorithms in various environments and assess their optimization of flight paths. This study not only demonstrates the practicality of PSO and WPA in UAV trajectory planning but also provides robust algorithmic support for future UAV applications.

articleTitle: Simulation Platform Architecture Design for Side Channel Attack
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The side channel attack simulation platform simulates and analyzes the characteristics and effects of side channel attacks. Through simulation, the principle and process of attacks can be understood, and effective defense countermeasures can be found through continuous debugging and optimization. Therefore, an architecture design of side-channel attack simulation platform is proposed, which adopts component technology and has strong flexibility. Test data and analysis strategy can be selected according to needs.

articleTitle: Design Concept of a Wearable Device for Sleep Related Brain Wave Detection and Stimulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper presents a design concept of an innovative wearable device for brain wave detection and stimulation to aid sleep. Sleep's importance for a healthy life emphasizes the value of studying the application of technology to improve sleep quality for individuals unable to receive a good night's rest. Utilizing electroencephalography (EEG) for accurate sleep tracking, the device aims to be portable and efficient. It includes the EEG sensing and processing module, adaptive control and machine learning module, and electronic stimulation module, working together to guide the brain toward relaxation. Preliminary results demonstrate promising performances or necessities of the subsystems of the proposed design.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of High-Performance Electronic Devices in Computer Hardware Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper first designs a hardware acceleration algorithm based on high-performance electronic devices to optimize the processing efficiency of computationally intensive tasks. By designing a specific algorithm architecture and parallelization mode, the execution speed of computing tasks can be improved. In addition, this paper builds a simulation model to test the performance of the algorithm in practical applications. The simulation results show that compared with traditional methods, the computer hardware acceleration system using high-performance electronic devices can achieve significant acceleration effects. In terms of data analysis, the superiority of this design is further verified by accurately measuring and analyzing the acceleration ratio, energy efficiency, and processing time of different computing tasks. Specifically, the hardware acceleration system based on high-performance electronic devices shows an average acceleration effect of more than 30% in image processing and data analysis tasks, while saving 15% in energy consumption. This research shows that the integration of high-performance electronic devices not only greatly improves the performance of computing systems, but also provides a new reference for the future development of computer hardware acceleration technology.

articleTitle: Research on Unit Regulation Strategy Based on the Remaining Power of Energy Storage Battery
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the unit adjustment strategy based on the remaining energy of the energy storage battery, and timely adjusts the unit side control according to the SOC state of the remaining energy storage battery, and does not purely rely on the action of the energy storage side, so that the SOC of the battery remaining energy is always maintained at the middle value. It takes full advantages of battery energy storage frequency modulation response speed to act as much as possible for each secondary frequency-modulation AGC (automatic generation control) and primary frequency modulation. It can reduce battery loss and extend battery life. It can actively respond to each AGC and one FM action command, bringing considerable economic benefits to the power plant.

articleTitle: An LSTM-based Path Switching Approach for Edge Gateways in Industrial Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Traditional path-switching methods are primarily designed for static or conventional network environments, ren-dering them inadequate for the dynamic nature of heterogeneous industrial networks. This paper aims to tackle the dual challenges of efficient path switching and accurate traffic prediction in such environments. First, an LSTM-based predictive model is developed to forecast critical network performance metrics, such as delay and load, facilitating proactive path adjustments. Second, a dynamic path-switching strategy is introduced, taking advantage of these predictions to minimize path oscillations and maintain stable network performance under varying traffic conditions. Finally, the performance of the proposed method is evaluated using key metrics, including latency, load distribution, and path stability. Simulation and experimental results confirm the effectiveness of the approach, demonstrating significant improvements in latency reduction, load balance, and overall network efficiency within industrial heterogeneous networks.

articleTitle: Adaptive Inertia Control Strategy for Virtual Synchronous Generators Based on RBF Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: An adaptive virtual synchronous generator control (VSG) algorithm is proposed in this paper which can adaptively adjust the virtual parameters of the system, thereby exhibiting good stability under different interference conditions. Compared to ordinary synchronous generators, VSGs offer more flexible parameter adjustability, with virtual inertia and virtual damping having significant impacts on system stability. Leveraging the RBF neural network's excellent approximation capabilities, simple algorithm, and fast learning characteristics, an improved RBF neural network was designed to meet real-time control requirements and was used for online adjustment of the VSG's virtual inertia. The virtual damping was adaptively regulated based on a fixed damping ratio. A photovoltaic hybrid energy storage system was constructed in Slmulink, integrating the neural network algorithm to establish an adaptive simulation model, thereby verifying the effectiveness of this control strategy. As the results shows that adaptive control strategy can effectively enhances the frequency stability of the VSG, providing new insights into frequency control for power system.

articleTitle: SinHuman3D: Novel Multi-View Synthesis and 3D Reconstruction from a Single Human Image
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This research introduces SinHuman3D, a framework designed for multi-view synthesis and three-dimensional reconstruction from a single human image, utilizing deep learning techniques in conjunction with Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) technology. The framework integrates a global feature extraction module, a detailed feature extraction component, and a Transformer-based feature fusion approach, alongside the incorporation of prior knowledge from the SMPL human model. An effective feature extraction and fusion strategy is proposed for high-fidelity 3D human model reconstruction. Experimental validation on the Render People dataset demonstrates SinHuman3D's superior performance in 3D reconstruction quality, structural fidelity, and perceptual similarity, achieving a PSNR of 21.72, an SSIM of 0.87, and an LPIPS of 0.14, highlighting its effectiveness in human 3D reconstruction.

articleTitle: Physical-Layer Security Scheme for 32QAM OFDM-PON Using Geometric Probabilistic Shaping and Chaos
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A 32QAM OFDM-PON physical-layer security scheme using geometric probability shaping (G/PS) and chaos is proposed in order to enhance transmission security and reliability. The encrypted signals are validated on a net bit rate of 42.74 Gb/s 32 quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) OFDM-PON system, which is transmitted over 20km SSMF fiber. The simulation results show the scheme can effectively expand the key space to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">127</sup>, achieves about 1.8 dB gain at a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> and maintains generalized mutual information (GMI) gain up to 0.58 bits/symbol, thus achieving good transmission security reliability.

articleTitle: Deformable ConvNets and Muti-Scale Linear Attention for Brain Tumor Segmentation with Missing Modalities
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Brain tumor segmentation extracts meaningful information from various modalities (T1, Tlc, T2, and FLAIR), each offering unique insights into brain structure and pathology, essential for accurate tumor subregion delineation. A common clinical challenge is the inability to acquire all modalities due to factors like image corruption or varying protocols. In such cases, most multimodal methods struggle with incomplete inputs, leading to poor performance. This paper proposes a network model, named as DCMLA-Net, using deformable convolution and multi-scale linear attention, effective for any subset of available modalities. Specifically, the deformable convolution extracts modality-specific information, while linear attention fuses multi-scale features, after which the fused features are fed into a deformable convolution decoder to restore spatial resolution and generate the final tumor segmentation. Experiments on the BraTS 2018 dataset show that the proposed method outperforms existing approaches with missing modalities.

articleTitle: Novel IoT Intelligent Medication Dispenser
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Senior people living at home or in senior assisted living facilities (senior home/apartment) face many daily life difficulties. A significant one is being unable to take correct medicine on time. To combat this challenge, a smart IoT-based device has been developed to facilitate and ensure seniors to be able to take medicine on time with correct types and dosages.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Large Language Models in FPGA Verification Test Requirement Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Focusing on the common functions in FPGA verification tests, this study adopts three different prompting strategies-standard prompting, chain-of-thought-based prompting, and example-based prompting-to evaluate the application prospects and performance of large language models (LLMs) in FPGA verification test requirement extraction. The results demonstrate that LLMs show promising application potential in the task of requirement extraction, especially when integrated with an FPGA verification test knowledge base. Among these three strategies, example-based prompting stands out, as it generates high-quality test requirements comparable to those produced by the chain-of-thought-based prompting, while also reducing the time required for strategy formulation. In contrast, standard prompting demonstrates weaker performance in the stability of requirement generation. The findings of this study strongly support the application of LLMs in the task of requirement extraction, and provide valuable insights into developing more efficient and accurate systems for extracting FPGA verification test requirements in the future.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Monitoring Network for Charge Consumption in Distributed Energy Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Traditional charge consumption prediction methods are hindered by the challenges posed by the dispersed locations of distributed energy stations, the complexity of network planning, and the stringent requirements for operational efficiency, leading to difficulties in providing accurate and efficient forecasts. This paper proposes the VAGnet network, which utilizes a VAE-GAN architecture for predicting charge consumption in distributed energy stations. VAGnet integrates a multi-source heterogeneous information fusion strategy, enabling real-time monitoring across various operational states. A collaborative planning strategy based on multidimensional data sharing is also introduced to enhance real-time tracking accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that VAGnet can effectively predict charge consumption at future time intervals, significantly improving the efficiency of real-time monitoring systems. This scalable solution meets the growing demands for precision and responsiveness in distributed energy station networks.

articleTitle: RD Imaging Algorithm Based on the Waveform with Costas-FSK and 4-PSK for Synthetic Aperture Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) is an important representative of modern radar technology, which are widely used in the field of target detection, location and imaging. In order to prevent the signal transmitted by active radar from being detected and intercepted by the enemy, the radar waveform needs to have the characteristics of low interception. In this paper, the imaging performance of a complex encoded waveform in range doppler (RD) imaging algorithm is studied. By adding frequency symbol keying (FSK) based on Costas encoding and phase symbol keying (PSK) to the single frequency signal, the waveform has the characteristics of low interception with frequency hopping and high randomness. At the same time, due to the characteristic that RD algorithm's azimuth matching filter is not affected by signal waveform, it still maintains good target detection and imaging performance based on this waveform.

articleTitle: Research on the New Generation of Network Data Security Protection Technology for Zero-Trust Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to effectively evaluate the security and situation of network data, this study puts forward the analysis method of the new generation of network data security for zero-trust environment. We need to build the network data security situation evaluation system according to the step level form, quantify data security risk assessment using a binary semantic model, and allocate evaluation index attribute weights based on data feature weights the safe and situation evaluation results of the data are obtained according to the positive and negative ideal value of the weighted decision matrix. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively and comprehensively evaluate the safe steady-state of network data. Compared to traditional data security assessment models, it has significant advantages.

articleTitle: Research on the Fusion of Superpixels in High-Resolution Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of small UAV remote sensing technology and the gradual improvement of observation system, high-resolution remote sensing images become easy to obtain, and China has entered the era of application of high-resolution remote sensing images. Traditional image segmentation methods treat pixels as processing units, focusing solely on spectral information while neglecting the influence of other image features. This approach fails to meet the accuracy and efficiency requirements for practical applications in high-resolution remote sensing image segmentation. Representing a high-resolution remote sensing image with superpixels aligns better with human visual perception, reduces information redundancy, and decreases data processing volume. Therefore, superpixel-based segmentation methods for high-resolution remote sensing images have become an important research direction. This paper primarily investigates the fusion of superpixels in high-resolution remote sensing images, elaborating on the principles of the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm and explaining a proposed spatially constrained fuzzy clustering method that integrates spectral differences. Qualitative and quantitative analyses of the experimental results are conducted to validate the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Diagnosis Algorithm of Leakage Current in Low Voltage Distribution Network Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of smart grids, the security of power systems has become a key issue. This paper discusses a smart leakage current diagnosis method for low-voltage distribution networks. This study mainly uses the BP neural network model, the LightGBM algorithm, and the LightGBM model combined with the IWOA (Imperialist Competitive Algorithm) optimization strategy to conduct leakage current diagnosis. The performance differences between the three are compared and analyzed. The BP neural network simulates the working principle of neurons in the human brain to perform nonlinear mapping and can capture complex data features. The LightGBM is an efficient gradient boosting framework that uses the leaf-wise growth strategy and histogram cache acceleration technology to make the model training more efficient. Furthermore, by introducing the IWOA optimizer to optimize the parameters of the LightGBM model, we have achieved the best results in leakage current diagnosis, improving the accuracy of diagnosis and enhancing the model's generalization ability. The experimental results show that, on the same test set, the IWOA-based LightGBM model has a significant advantage in computational efficiency while maintaining a high prediction accuracy. Although the BP neural network can achieve a higher accuracy in some cases, it has some shortcomings in training time and resource consumption compared to LightGBM. Taking into account the diagnosis accuracy and system operational efficiency, the IWOA-based LightGBM is more suitable for real-time monitoring of low-voltage distribution network leakage fault diagnosis. This study not only provides more reliable leakage fault diagnosis methods for low-voltage distribution networks, but also lays a foundation for further improving the intelligentization level of the grid. Future research directions will focus on improving the algorithm's real-time performance and adaptability to complex grid environments.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Processing and Recognition of Complex Images Combined with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, image processing technology plays an increasingly important role in many fields. However, traditional methods face many limitations when dealing with complex and fuzzy images, and it isn't easy to achieve accurate recognition and segmentation. Aiming at this challenge, this study developed an improved YOLOv5 complex image segmentation model with efficient complex image processing and segmentation using advanced image processing and deep learning technologies. According to the image characteristics, this study carried out efficient image preprocessing, including several steps such as grayscale processing, noise removal, edge enhancement, binarization, and morphological processing, to significantly improve the image quality and highlight key features to optimize the effective recognition area. Then, this study introduced the YOLOv5 object detection model of the SE attention mechanism with the processed image as the input end. The experimental results show that the model has made remarkable achievements in key indicators such as precision and recall rate, which not only shows the strong advantages of deep learning in processing complex images but also provides strong support for further research.

articleTitle: Research on the Localization Method of Meter Box Leakage Current Combining Data Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the increasing emphasis on the operational safety of electrical equipment, the detection and localization of leakage current in meter boxes has become an important issue in power system maintenance. This paper proposes a leakage current localization method for meter boxes (DF -CNN) that combines data fusion technology. The core of this method lies in the use of data collected from multiple sensors, which are processed through data fusion algorithms to achieve precise localization of the leakage current. First, we introduced a multi-source data collection mechanism, including current sensors, temperature sensors, and humidity sensors, among others, which can collect multidimensional information about the meter box and its surrounding environment in real-time. By comprehensively processing this information, we can gain a more comprehensive understanding of the operating status of the meter box and potential leakage risks. Second, in data preprocessing and feature extraction, we employed a data fusion algorithm that can integrate data from different sensors, extracting information related to the location of the leakage current. By effectively integrating these different data types, we improve the positioning accuracy. Finally, in terms of algorithm design, we first constructed a leakage current model and used a convolutional neural network to train and classify the features after fusion. Through optimizing algorithm parameters and feature selection, we ultimately achieved rapid localization of the leakage current source. The experimental results show that the positioning method combining data fusion technology has a high positioning accuracy in the detection of leakage current, significantly superior to the existing methods. This research provides new ideas and methods for the fault diagnosis and maintenance of electrical equipment, which is of great significance for improving the safety of the power system.

Author Keywords: Meter Box Leakage Current Positioning Method

articleTitle: An Improved Crayfish Optimization Algorithm and Its Application in Enhancing Low-light Image Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The Crayfish Optimization Algorithm (COA) is a metaheuristic optimization algorithm renowned for its rapid convergence and balanced exploration-exploitation trade-off. However, it frequently encounters issues of local optima entrapment when addressing certain problems. To overcome this limitation, we propose an enhanced version called the Improved Crayfish Optimization Algorithm (ICOA). In ICOA, a temperature regulation mechanism is introduced to modulate exploration and exploitation, with distinct temperature coefficients applied during the summer resort, competition, and foraging stages. Additionally, random mutation, dimensional mutation, and Cauchy mutation are incorporated into ICOA to maintain population diversity and enhance search capabilities. Experimental evaluations, including benchmark function tests and low-light image enhancement experiments, demonstrate that ICOA improves search accuracy by 8.97% and convergence speed by 32.52 %, exhibiting superior performance in low-light image enhancement applications.

articleTitle: Research on Machine Vision Intelligent Detection System Based on Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, visual inspection and image processing algorithms have been continuously improved in accuracy and efficiency, and intelligent inspection systems based on machine vision have been widely used in product quality control, defect detection and process monitoring. In this paper, a machine vision intelligent inspection system based on Faster Region-based Convolutional Network (Faster R-CNN) is proposed, which aims to improve the detection accuracy and efficiency. In this paper, the overall architecture of the system is introduced, including the image acquisition module, the data preprocessing module and the detection module based on Faster R-CNN. In the data preprocessing module, the Deep Convolution Generative Adversarial Networks (DCGAN) algorithm was proposed for image expansion generation, and high-resolution image samples that were basically consistent with the collected image datasets were obtained. Then, the Faster R-CNN model was optimized and adjusted for specific application scenarios, so that the average accuracy (mAP) of the model reached 78.23% and the FPS value reached 11.0.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Deep Learning-Based Computer Vision in Anomaly Detection in Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Network anomaly detection has become an important task for ensuring network security and stable operation. However, due to the increasing scale and complexity of communication networks, traditional detection methods have gradually shown limitations in handling large amounts of network data. This paper investigates the application of deep learning-based computer vision technology in communication network anomaly detection, aiming to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of anomaly detection through innovative algorithm design. To this end, this paper proposes a multi-layer deep model (CLA) that combines CNN and LSTM to efficiently capture the spatial and temporal features of network traffic images. The model converts network traffic data into image representations, utilizes CNN to extract spatial features, and then combines LSTM to capture correlations in the time series, significantly improving the accuracy of anomaly detection. Furthermore, this paper introduces an adaptive attention mechanism to focus on key features, effectively reducing noise interference and false positive rates. We did an experiment in network scenarios, validating its feasibility and advancement in practical applications, while also providing new ideas and solutions for the security protection of future communication networks.

articleTitle: Research on Lightweight YOLOv5 Model for Edge Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the workplace, smoking not only poses a threat to the environment and workers' health but also can lead to catastrophic consequences in factories with flammable materials or precision equipment. Therefore, promptly and accurately detecting and preventing smoking behavior in factories is crucial for ensuring safe production and reducing accidents. Using edge devices for detection is a natural approach. However, smoking detection models require high accuracy due to the small size of cigarette targets and the likelihood of being obscured by complex backgrounds and other objects. Traditional object detection models often focus on improving accuracy by increasing model size, such as Faster R-CNN and SSD. However, those approach typically results in models that are difficult to deploy on edge devices or low-power devices. Deploying models on embedded devices requires lightweighting to accommodate the resource constraints of the devices. This study introduces an enhanced version of the YOLOv5 model, aiming to improve model performance on edge devices while maintaining accuracy. First, to reduce redundancy in the YOLOv5 backbone network, CSPDarknet53 is replaced with MobileNetV3, leveraging its lightweight characteristics, and its feature extraction capabilities are improved by incorporating the CBAM attention mechanism. Secondly, a pruning method is proposed to further compress the model size, optimizing its performance on edge devices. The optimized model is named MobileNetV3-YOLOv5s-CBAM (MB3-YOLOv5-CBAM), and ablation experiments confirm the contributions of each optimization. Compared to the YOLOv5 model, the pruned MB3-YOLOv5-CBAM reduces the number of parameters by approximately 60.7%, memory usage by 89.5%, and achieves an inference speed of 123 FPS, an increase of about 16.2%. The model can accurately detect cigarettes, with good real-time performance a compact model size, making it more suitable for edge devices.

articleTitle: Study of Short-Term Wind Power Forecasting Using VMD Denoising and SSA-Optimized CBiLSTM-RF Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To address the issue of low prediction accuracy caused by the strong fluctuations in wind power generation, this paper proposes a combined forecasting model based on Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD), Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) optimized Convolutional Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Network (CBiLSTM), and Random Forest (RF). VMD is applied to break down the highly nonlinear wind power data into several modal components for the purpose of denoising. The SSA is introduced to optimize the hyperparameters of both the CBiLSTM and RF models. A CNN is constructed to perform feature extraction, which is subsequently input into the BiLSTM network to establish an ultra-short-term forecasting model. The results from the parameter-optimized RF prediction model are then combined through weighted allocation. The final prediction is obtained by summing the forecast results of all modal functions. In comparison with other forecasting models and single models, the proposed hybrid model exhibits significantly improved prediction accuracy, providing enhanced precision and stability.

Author Keywords: Convolutional Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Network

articleTitle: PSDiffusion: Research on High-Resolution Facial Reconstruction Based on Diffusion Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of image processing technology, there is an increasing demand for customized, high-precision portrait graphics. The clarity and level of detail in these images directly affect tasks such as personalized design, virtual character creation, and facial beautification. Traditional methods for image customization are labor-intensive and time-consuming. Recently, diffusion models in the field of image processing have demonstrated significant progress in generating customized images. These computational approaches greatly reduce time costs while simultaneously providing multiple beautification and design options. To better generate art-enhanced images based on individual facial features, we propose the PSdiffusion (Portrait Styling Diffusion) model. To address the extended training times and high memory usage associated with traditional diffusion models, our model incorporates an Image Compression Module. Additionally, we optimize the Condition Information Module to enhance image controllability and mitigate the loss caused by compressed training. We further introduce an F-ESRGAN (Face-ESRGAN) high-definition module to improve image clarity, facilitating more detailed reference for designers. To address the lack of existing datasets for virtual character design, we also contribute a medium-sized, high-resolution dataset with detailed categorization and annotation. On the PSimage dataset, our model achieves an average MOS score of 4.23, with a PCT win ratio of 31.67 against three popular models, significantly outperforming most existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on a Neural Machine Translation-Based Approach for Production-Test Code Co-evolution
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: During the evolution of software, test cases should evolve alongside the production code. Detecting and updating outdated test cases in a timely manner helps lower maintenance costs and prevent potential defects. However, existing methods face limitations in co-evolution pattern mining and automated test code debugging, with rule construction being complex and lacking end-to-end production-test code co-evolution. This study proposes a Neural Machine Translation-based Co-evolution method, NPTCC (Neural Production-Test Code Co-evolution), which analyzes historical commits of production and test code to extract test case features. A neural network classifier and a Transformer updater model are trained separately to identify and update outdated tests, with updated test cases generated through beam search followed by abstraction recovery and syntax checking. Experimental results show that NPTCC significantly improves accuracy in identification and updating tasks compared to traditional methods, with generated test cases performing well in dynamic and manual evaluations. Furthermore, an NPTCC-supported co-evolution system has been developed, enabling developers to automatically identify and update outdated tests, effectively reducing maintenance costs and improving code quality.

articleTitle: A Study on Functional Coverage-Driven Random Stimulus Generation Methods for Integrated Circuit Functional Verification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The rapid advancement of integrated circuit technology has led to an exponential increase in the scale and complexity of System-on-Chip designs, making chip verification the most time-consuming and resource-intensive phase in the development process. Traditional verification methods struggle to comprehensively cover all functional scenarios, adversely affecting verification efficiency and time-to-market. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel rule-based functional coverage-driven random stimulus generation method. By establishing a correspondence between coverage points and constraint conditions, the proposed method dynamically updates the constraints for stimulus generation based on functional coverage information. This approach reduces redundant stimuli generation and accelerates verification convergence. Experimental results demonstrate that the method enhances verification efficiency, reduces redundant test stimuli, and more effectively covers unverified functional points. This research offers new insights for improving verification automation and the reusability of verification platforms, holding substantial practical engineering value.

articleTitle: HOA Algorithm Optimized L1-Regularized Conformable Fractional Grey System Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper introduces an L1-regularized conformable fractional grey model (CFGM-L1) optimized using the hiking optimization algorithm (HOA). The CFGM-L1 model aims to enhance predictive accuracy by addressing the limitations of traditional grey models in handling high-dimensional and complex data. By incorporating L1 regularization, the model effectively reduces the number of parameters, automatically selects significant features, and prevents overfitting, thereby improving generalization. The HOA is employed to optimize the parameters of the CFGM-L1 model, leveraging a novel metaheuristic approach inspired by hikers' movement patterns to achieve better performance in complex data scenarios. Numerical examples demonstrate the superiority of the CFGM-L1 model over traditional grey models, showcasing significant improvements in prediction accuracy with reduced mean absolute percentage error (MAPE). The results indicate that the proposed approach is a robust and effective method for complex data modeling, with potential applications across various fields.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-wind Disturbance Controller of Tiltrotor UAV Based on ADRC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Tiltrotor unmanned aerial vehicles can take off and land vertically in a small space, and can also cruise at high speed, so there will be broad development space in the future. However, rotary wing unmanned aerial vehicle themselves have the characteristics of strong coupling and nonlinearity, it is susceptible to the interference of near the ground wind to fail the task during vertical takeoff and landing, causing economic losses. In response to this issue, this paper analyzes the impact of near ground wind on aircraft attitude, and designs a self-adaptive wind resistant controller based on the principle of active disturbance rejection control, and the experiments of the vertical take-off and suspension of UAVs is performed under the conditions of simulation of external wind fields. The simulation results show that when taking off and landing vertically in a windy environment, the controller can accurately estimate the wind disturbance received and compensate for the control variables, resulting in a significant reduction and more stable in the oscillation of the UAV's various attitudes, and being enhanced wind resistance.

articleTitle: Digital Twin of Airport Departure Systems for Anomaly Detection and Trend Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As the importance of departure equipment in modern aviation transportation continues to grow, ensuring its proper operation and promptly identifying potential anomalies have become critical. This study proposes a novel approach leveraging digital twin technology for real-time anomaly detection and future performance prediction of airport departure equipment. By constructing digital twin models, the operational states of the equipment can be dynamically monitored in real time. Combining machine learning and time-series analysis, historical equipment data is used to train the model, enabling accurate anomaly detection and trend prediction. Additionally, the digital twin model forecasts the future states of the equipment, providing valuable data for maintenance planning and resource allocation. Experimental results demonstrate that this method significantly enhances anomaly detection accuracy, minimizes the impact of equipment failures, and offers reliable decision support for airport departure operations. This study not only provides new insights into the intelligent management and maintenance of airport equipment but also serves as a reference for applying digital twin technology to complex systems.

articleTitle: PID Parameter Tuning Method of Reluctance Motor Based on Improved RBF-AHP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: During the operation of a reluctance motor (RM), the output torque fluctuates periodically. Meanwhile, torque pulsation causes the motor rotor to produce unstable torque during rotation, resulting in noise radiation. This paper proposes the PID parameter tuning method based on an improved RBF-AHP algorithm to solve the above problem. RBF-AHP algorithm is a multi-attribute decision-making algorithm, which combines radial basis function and analytic hierarchy method. The RBF-AHP algorithm uses the results of the RBF model to calculate the weight and the AHP algorithm to take the consistency test, rather than directly using the original judgment matrix. The weight of RBF-AHP is used for total hierarchy ranking, and the final decision result is obtained. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, MATLAB/Simulink software is used to simulate the SRM torque control system based on the improved RBF-AHP algorithm, and the system oscillation is effectively reduced.

articleTitle: SRGAN Optimization Through Enhanced Network Structure and Multi-Loss Functions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: An enhanced SRGAN image super-resolution algorithm is proposed to address SRGAN's training instability and limited global information capture. This enhancement optimizes both the network structure and loss function. In network structure optimization, group normalization is introduced as an alternative to batch normalization, addressing its dependency on batch size and improving stability during small-batch training. Additionally, Global Context Block (GCBlock) is integrated into the residual block, enhancing the network's global information capture and detail representation capabilities. In regard to the loss function, this paper introduces L1 loss and MS-SSIM loss as alternatives to the conventional MSE loss. This approach aims to enhance the quality of the generated image in both pixel space and structural information while reducing the smoothing effect. In the experimental section, the ablation experiments evaluate the performance of models with and without GCBlock on five test sets, including U rban1 00 and Manga109. The results demonstrate that GCBlock improves both detail expressiveness and global information capture, with an average PSNR gain of 0.1388 and SSIM improvement of 0.008. In comparison experiments, the improved algorithm achieved an average PSNR increase of 0.270 and an average SSIM increase of 0.018 on the aforementioned test set, indicating a significant improvement in detail expression and visual quality. Finally, the limitations of the enhanced algorithm are discussed, and potential future research directions are proposed.

articleTitle: YOLOV8-ADS: A Lightweight Algorithm for Target Detection in Small-Area Unmanned Surface Vehicle Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Detecting surface targets is a significant challenge in unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) perception systems. Both detection accuracy and processing speed are crucial for effective deployment, yet current algorithms often struggle to identify floating objects with the necessary precision and efficiency. This paper proposes an improved, lightweight YOLOv8-ADS algorithm tailored for detecting floating objects in small urban waterways. Firstly, to reduce the interference from water surface noise, the ADown module is introduced, merging average and max pooling strengths. This method balances local averaging and maximum pooling, minimizing noise-induced instability and enhancing feature map robustness. Secondly, to preserve critical image details during upsampling, the standard upsampling module is replaced with the DySample module, which dynamically adjusts sampling strategies to produce clearer fused feature maps, thus improving detection accuracy of small targets in aquatic environments. Additionally, to address the challenges of small targets, varying scales, and complex backgrounds in urban water areas, the SEAM attention mechanism is added to the detection head to focus on essential features while reducing model parameters. Finally, the Layer-wise Adaptive Magnitude-based Pruning (LAMP) technique is employed to prune the optimized model, leading to a further decrease in its computational requirements. The findings from the Multi-Class Floating Waste (MCFW) dataset indicate that the proposed method significantly improves mAP@0.5 by 5.2% and mAP@0.5:0.95 by 4.7% when compared to the baseline model. Additionally, it achieves a reduction in GFLOPs by 34.6% and lowers the number of model parameters by 33.9%. The refined algorithm establishes a harmonious equilibrium between detection precision and computational intricacy, rendering it particularly adept at identifying diminutive targets on water surfaces.

articleTitle: Rapidly Varying Channel State Estimation Employing Deep Learning Techniques for Predictive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the gradual development of 5G technology and the in-depth research of 6G technology, many high-speed mobile application scenarios have put forward more stringent performance requirements for mobile communication networks. Specifically, the communication link must ensure extremely low error rates while meeting the dual demands of high communication quality and high transmission rate. In view of this, adaptive link adjustment technology has become the focus of industry research. However, one key foundation for achieving adaptive link technology is the ability to accurately sense channel state information (CSI).
