Given this, this paper adopts the deep learning technology of Transformer based on attention mechanism and combines the CNN-LSTM model based on neural network and LSTM network with fast-varying signal prediction to innovatively integrate it with Transformer technology for the first time, constructing a novel model for fast-varying channel prediction-CLTE (CNN-LSTM-based Transformer Prediction Model). Through experimental verification, the model achieves an average performance improvement of 0.8 to 1.5 in the mean square error (MSE) of SNR prediction value compared to the traditional CLSTM-based CSI prediction model. Consequently, the efficacy of adaptive link deployment within the context of rapid-channel prediction is set to be enhanced.

articleTitle: Application of Passive Wireless Temperature Monitoring Equipment in Temperature Monitoring of 220kV High Voltage Electrical Connection Components
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: 220kV high-voltage electrical coupling components play a key role in the power station outlet field and are an important part of the power transmission system. However, due to the long-term operation process, the connecting parts are susceptible to internal stress, deformation and loosening, oxidative corrosion and foreign body isolation and other factors, resulting in increased contact resistance, abnormal heating, and even equipment failure or damage. Therefore, real-time monitoring of the temperature of the connecting parts has become an important measure to ensure the stable operation of the power system. At present, the application of traditional wired temperature sensors in high-voltage scenarios has problems such as wiring difficulties and inconvenient power supply, while wireless temperature sensors improve flexibility. However, the battery life is limited, and there are frequent maintenance and other deficiencies. This paper presents a temperature monitoring device based on passive wireless technology, which is applied to the temperature monitoring of 220kV high-voltage electrical connection components. The device does not need to rely on battery power supply, and realizes long-term stable operation of temperature sensing terminal through passive wireless technology, which can monitor the temperature change of electrical connection components in real time and accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Correction System of 3D Image Reconstruction Error Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and stability of 3D image reconstruction, an intelligent correction system based on generative adversarial network (GAN), convolutional neural network (CNN) and Bat algorithm (BA) is proposed. As a powerful generative model, generative adversarial network can effectively generate high-quality images through adversarial training mechanism, while convolutional neural network is excellent in feature extraction. Combining these two advantages, we can build a generator and discriminator with excellent performance for achieving high-quality 3D image reconstruction. By simulating the echolocation behavior of bats in the process of hunting, the bat algorithm can find the optimal parameters in the complex solution space, thus accelerating the convergence of the model and improving the reconstruction accuracy. In the process of model training, the Bat algorithm constantly adjusts the learning rate, batch size and other hyperparameters to adapt to different reconstruction scenarios and improve the overall performance. Through experimental verification, the proposed model shows superior performance in 3D image reconstruction tasks, which is significantly superior to traditional methods and other deep learning models. The experimental results show that the intelligent correction system can effectively reduce the reconstruction error and improve the image quality, which provides a new idea and method for the research of 3D image reconstruction.

articleTitle: An Improved Slime Mould Optimization Algorithm Based on Integrating Multiple Strategies and Its Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-strategy enhanced slime mould algorithm (IMSMA) is proposed to address issues such as population initialization, convergence speed, and the tendency to fall into local optima in the slime mould optimization algorithm (SMA). Firstly, an optimal point set is introduced for population initialization to enhance initial diversity and improve algorithm stability. Secondly, the fixed parameter controlling population randomness is adjusted to adaptively change with the iteration number, balancing the exploration capability at the beginning phases and the optimization capability in the final phases. Additionally, a convergence stagnation judgment mechanism is incorporated to prevent premature convergence. Comparative experiments with similar intelligent optimization algorithms and the original SMA on functions from CEC2014 demonstrate that the enhanced algorithm achieves better stability and accuracy. Finally, the improved algorithm is applied to search for SVM kernel parameters, and experiments on eight UCI datasets further validate the feasibility and practicality of the enhanced algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Optimization Image Recognition Algorithm in Computer-Aided 3D Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: How to generate and recognize 3D models efficiently and accurately is a key problem in image recognition. To solve this problem, Cubes Cycle Particle Swarm (CCPS), a new method combining CycleGAN, Marching Cubes (MC) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), is proposed in this paper. CCPS method can capture key features in the image to achieve the conversion from 2D image to 3D model through CycleGAN, and Marching Cubes algorithm is used to generate smooth 3D surface according to voxel data. At the same time, PSO is used for intelligent optimization, and the optimal solution is found through particle swarm collaborative search, so as to ensure high reconstruction accuracy and improve the robustness and recognition efficiency of the model. Finally, through the comparison experiment and analysis with traditional image recognition algorithms, the experimental results show that CCPS method has significant advantages in improving image recognition accuracy, image recognition effect and enhancing system robustness. Especially in complex model reconstruction, CCPS method can generate and identify 3D models more accurately, and reduce the error rate and missing rate. This fully verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of this architecture in intelligent optimization of image recognition algorithm in computer-aided 3D modeling.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Traffic Scheduling Algorithm Based on Huawei Network Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of network applications, network traffic is increasing, and traditional traffic scheduling methods are no longer able to meet the efficient and flexible network requirements. This paper proposes a dynamic traffic scheduling algorithm based on Huawei network devices to optimize network resource utilization, reduce delay, and avoid network congestion. First, the traffic control characteristics of Huawei routers and switches are analyzed, and the existing five traffic scheduling methods are analyzed and evaluated. A dynamic scheduling mechanism based on priority queues is then designed, which can monitor network status in real-time and automatically adjust bandwidth allocation according to different traffic patterns. Second, the effectiveness of the algorithm in handling burst traffic and large-scale data transmission is verified through simulation experiments. The results show that the proposed dynamic traffic scheduling algorithm significantly improves data transmission efficiency and enhances the overall network performance. Finally, the paper discusses the potential application of the algorithm in real network environments and the future directions for improvement, providing a basis for further research.

articleTitle: Online Evaluation of Potential Transformer Operating Conditions Based on Similarity and Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The paper proposes a comprehensive method for online monitoring of potential transformers (PTs) based on similarity coefficient clustering and health index evaluation. By collecting and analyzing real-time operational data, the method calculates similarity coefficients to assess the condition of PTs and employs cluster analysis to group transformers with similar characteristics. A health index model is developed to provide an accurate evaluation of PT status, enabling more effective maintenance and fault prediction. The approach has been verified through case studies, demonstrating its potential for early fault detection, improved PT management, and reduced maintenance costs in power systems.

articleTitle: 3D X-ray Image Reconstruction Based on Collaborative Neural Radiance Field and Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This research examines the utilization of an integrated learner model that combines Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Neural Radiation Field (NeRF) for image reconstruction. The advancement of deep learning technology has led to significant progress in image reconstruction, particularly in addressing conventional issues such as image blurring, noise interference, and high computational demands. This work presents a model that integrates GRAF (Generated Radiation Field) with a unified learner designed to deduce anatomical 3D structures from a limited number or a single observation of X-rays. The model is trained using three distinct configurations of GAN models to enhance its stability and performance. In a generative adversarial network, the generator (G) strives to make counterfeit data that is indistinguishable from authentic data, whereas the discriminator (D) endeavors to differentiate between the genuine data and the counterfeit data generated by G. Through this adversarial training technique, the two entities iteratively co-evolve during the game to enhance model performance. The experimental results indicate that the model attains a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 35.01 and a structural similarity index (SSIM) of 0.928, demonstrating superior image quality and enhanced structural similarity. This research examines the model's potential and limitations in addressing the characteristics and issues of imaging data.

articleTitle: Dynamic Security Permission Management for Power IoT Edge Devices Based on Kolmogorov-Arnold Network and Zero Trust Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The escalating role of the Power Internet of Things (PIoT) in energy management highlights the urgent need for advanced security solutions to protect against evolving cyber threats. Integrating the Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) with the Zero Trust security architecture, this research presents a dynamic multi-attribute security permission management approach for P IoT edge devices. Critical to the integrity and stability of power systems, our method leverages KAN to predict trust levels based on device attributes such as ontological information, environmental context, and dynamic interaction behaviors, enabling the dynamic adjustment of access control rules. Our prototype system, demonstrating a prediction accuracy exceeding 96%, underscores the practicality of our approach in real-time security permission management as device attributes evolve. This study contributes significantly to the field by enhancing PIoT security, ensuring resilience against potential attacks.

articleTitle: Autonomous Driving Perception Method Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This study proposes a method based on the improved YOLOv8 algorithm for object detection in unmanned driving environment perception. By introducing the Conv2Former structure and combining the advantages of convolution operation and self-attention mechanism, the model's detection ability for complex backgrounds and multi-scale targets has been improved. The study employed data augmentation techniques such as Gaussian noise addition and random erasure to improve the model's adaptability to noise and occlusion situations. The experimental results show that the improved YOLOv8 algorithm achieves a mAP50 index of 0.462 on the validation set containing occluded samples and low light conditions, which is significantly better than traditional YOLOv8 and other classic object detection algorithms. This study provides new ideas and technical support for the development of autonomous driving technology. In the future, we will further explore deeper network structures, efficient data augmentation methods, and multimodal data fusion to promote the continuous progress of autonomous driving environment perception technology.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Task Power Large Vision Model Based on Hypernetwork Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the research of power large vision model. By carrying out the standardized collection and cleaning of power vision data sets, the feature extraction and representation of multi-task data, and the search and construction of general model architectures for power vision, an integrated process of constructing and training multi-task power large vision model based on the hypernetwork architecture is established. This enables the effective improvement of the inference performance of downstream task models, gives full play to the potential of the model under the existing parameters, and is conducive to the rapid and low-cost implementation of power business scenarios.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Ensemble Approach for Depression Detection: Combining Deep Learning and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The depression detection from text data represents a pragmatic application of machine learning and natural language processing in the mental health field. This paper presents a hybrid ensemble learning approach that combines conventional machine learning models, namely Naive Bayes, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Logistic Regression, with deep learning models, including the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Multi-Layer Perceptron networks. The hard voting for ensembling results in the ensemble model outperforming individual models on precision, on a par with the best model in terms of accuracy, F1-score, and recall. The evaluation of the models on a dataset of depression-related text posts indicates that the ensemble significantly reduces both false positives and false negatives, shown in the confusion matrix. The LSTM model, integrated into the ensemble, captures sequential dependencies in text, contributing to improved depression classification. This study demonstrates the interplay potential of machine learning and deep learning techniques to improve the balance and robustness of depression detection systems.

articleTitle: Multivariate Predictive Control Strategy for Multi-Rate Systems Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, the control method of multi-rate system based on dynamic Matrix control (DMC) strategy and neural network interpolation technique is studied. Aiming at the problem that the sampling period of the slow sampling output channel is not synchronized with the reference period in the multi-rate system, an improved model predictive control strategy is proposed. The proposed method improves the accuracy of the DMC control model by predicting the missing step response values through neural networks. At the same time, the prediction error filter is designed to cope with the specificity of the multi-rate system and enhance the system stability. Compared with traditional methods such as quadratic spline interpolation, the proposed method effectively solves the prediction and control problems of inconsistent sampling rates and non-sampling points, and improves the applicability in complex industrial processes. Finally, the proposed control strategy was applied to the simulation system of a typical heavy oil fractionating column. By setting different slow sampling periods and model mismatch degrees, it is verified that the DMC control algorithm based on neural network is significantly superior to the DMC control algorithm based on quadratic spline interpolation in terms of convergence speed and stability.

articleTitle: Failure Analysis of the Data Desensitization System for Civil Aviation Passenger Information Service Based on Bow Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the uncertainty of the factors affecting the security risk assessment of civil aviation passenger information service data desensitization system and the difficulty of index quantification, a failure analysis method combining bow-tie and Bayesian is proposed and applied to the security risk assessment of civil aviation passenger information service data desensitization system. First, the business security and network security problems faced by the civil aviation passenger information service data desensitization system are analyzed in light of the composition and business characteristics of the civil aviation passenger information service data desensitization system. Second, the factors of intermediate event sub-event occurrence are analyzed, and the bow-tie model is transformed into a bow-tie-Bayesian model utilizing logical mapping to explore further the probability of occurrence of sub-events and top-level events. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively assess the system risk, predict the attack path, reduce the influence of subjective factors on the risk assessment process, make the assessment results more in line with the actual situation, and provide a reference and basis for the selection of security protection strategies.

Author Keywords: Civil Aviation Passenger Information Service Data Desensitization System

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Recognition Algorithm of Case Images Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel multi-modal fusion framework for automatic classification and key information extraction of legal case documents and scene photos. Firstly, the powerful image feature extraction ability of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) was used to extract the visual features from the case pictures. Subsequently, Transformer models are introduced to process case text information to capture long-distance dependencies and contextual relationships. In order to integrate image and text information and further improve the recognition accuracy, we use XGBoost algorithm to build a classifier based on the output features of CNN and Transformer. With its high efficiency and powerful learning ability, it can effectively deal with high-dimensional feature space. The method accurately classifies the case images and achieves superior performance in the task of automatic classification of case images, which provides a new technical path for judicial image processing.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Scheduling Optimization Algorithms for Cloud Platform Business Systems in a Microservices Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a new framework called Markov Decision Genetics (MDG). This framework combines microservice architecture, Markov Decision Process (MDP) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) to solve the problem of resource scheduling optimization of cloud platform business system under microservice architecture. MDG framework formalizes resource scheduling problems through MDP and automatically optimizes resource allocation strategies through GA. This method can intelligently predict and adapt to the changes of system load, so as to realize efficient and dynamic resource scheduling. We have built a system architecture based on IaaS, PaaS, SaaS three-layer cloud service model, which provides comprehensive support for the research of resource scheduling optimization algorithm of cloud platform business system under microservice architecture. Finally, this paper verifies the significant advantages of the proposed cloud-native architecture based business system resource scheduling optimization algorithm in terms of accuracy, scientific decision making and overall efficiency improvement by comparing the model algorithm with the neural network algorithm. The results show that the resource scheduling optimization algorithm can effectively solve the complexity and uncertainty problems that the traditional scheduling methods are difficult to deal with, and also prove the effectiveness of the model in the optimization and feasibility of business system resource scheduling.

articleTitle: Information Fusion of Infrared Image and Visible Image for Robot Localization Under Extremely Low Illuminati on
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In scenarios characterized by diminished ambient lighting, a solitary source image proves inadequate for precise localization of the robot, thereby potentially impeding subsequent visual SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) endeavours. Although infrared cameras offer the advantage of capturing discernible images irrespective of lighting conditions, they may concurrently introduce distortions in the background and finer details of the image. This study introduces a novel approach for enhancing robot localization under low illumination conditions by integrating infrared imagery with low-light information. Our method employs a new weighted fusion strategy and works in conjunction with a photometric sensor to ensure that the robot has sufficient image information in low environments with different low illumination intensities and lighting variations. The efficacy of the proposed system is assessed based on the requisite number of feature points essential for accurate robot localization and is benchmarked against established methodologies. Experimental scrutiny of the weighted fusion technique delineated in this paper corroborates its ability to yield a higher count of feature points conducive to robot localization while concurrently furnishing a more holistic depiction of the image.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Algorithm of Self-Healing Control Strategy of Substation Based on Flexible Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimization scheme that integrates extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) and reinforcement learning algorithm, and designs a self-healing control strategy for flexible interconnected substations. Firstly, a flexible interconnection model of each node in the substation is constructed, and the network stability under different fault conditions is analyzed. Subsequently, the extreme gradient boosting algorithm is introduced to train the model through large-scale historical data, so as to predict key parameters such as voltage and load in different substations under abnormal conditions. In the simulation test, real substation operation data is used to simulate a variety of fault scenarios to verify the effectiveness of the strategy. The results show that the algorithm not only improves the accuracy of fault location and isolation, but also significantly shortens the recovery time and achieves a self-healing success rate of more than 90%. Through precise data analysis, the practicality of the algorithm in complex power grid environments is verified, reflecting its advantages in improving the self-healing ability of the system, reducing power outage time and improving power supply reliability.

Author Keywords: Extreme Gradient Boosting Combined with Reinforcement Learning Algorithm

articleTitle: PDDM: IP Image Design via Diffusion Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Traditional methods and models, while capable of generating high-quality images, often require substantial human resources and time, limiting their feasibility for large-scale applications. To address these challenges, this paper proposes the Pose-Directed Diffusion Model. Through optimized training of this module, the model in this paper significantly reduces training time. Additionally, the model in this paper integrates the Pro-ControlNet module to enhance fine control during the image generation process. Importantly, this paper constructs a new CCC Image Collection dataset, featuring precise classifications, detailed annotations, and high-resolution images. The experimental results on the CCC Image Collection dataset demonstrate that our model performs excellently in terms of evaluation metrics such as MSE, PSNR, and SSIM. It shows significant improvement in training effectiveness on the original dataset, with outstanding performance both in terms of absolute error measurement and visual perception by the human eye.

articleTitle: A Study of Salient Object Detection Based on Multilevel Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Salient Object Detection (SOD) is designed to identify and segment the most significant objects or regions in an image. Most existing SOD methods typically use U-Net or feature pyramid structures to simply aggregate features at different scales, which often leads to a mixture of low-level noise and a lack of high-level details, ultimately resulting in degraded model performance. In response to this issue, this paper proposes the Saliency Multi-Dimension Attention Network (SMDA-Net) for significant object detection. Firstly, the Multilevel Interaction Module (MIM) is proposed, which introduces a cross-attention mechanism to facilitate the interaction between features at different levels, enabling high-level features to guide the learning of low-level features and enhance salient regions. Secondly, to address the problem that Transformer-based SOD methods tend to ignore the details of complex objects, the Hybrid Attention Module (HAM) is designed, which combines global self-attention and windowed self-attention to model the context at both global and local levels, thereby improving the accuracy and detail retention of the prediction map. Finally, a multilevel supervision strategy is adopted to optimize the decoding process in stages. Experimental results show that SMDA-Net outperforms current state-of-the-art models on challenging datasets, providing a more effective method for significant object detection and being of great significance to the development of this field.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Objective Optimization of Low-Carbon Cold Chain Routes Using LNS-NSGA2 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper addresses the high costs, stringent time sensitivity, and perishability issues encountered in the cold chain logistics of fresh products. To tackle these challenges, a multi-objective low-carbon cold chain route optimization model is established. This model aims to simultaneously minimize the total cost (comprising transportation cost, cargo damage cost, and carbon emission cost), while maximizing customer satisfaction (encompassing both time satisfaction and quality satisfaction). To achieve this goal, we propose the LNS-NSGA2 algorithm, which integrates the advantages of local search strategies with genetic algorithms. Building upon the traditional NSGA2 algorithm, the LNS-NSGA2 algorithm incorporates the “destroy” and “repair” mechanisms from the LNS (Large Neighborhood Search) algorithm, coupled with a binary tournament selection strategy, to enhance the algorithm's local search capability and thus exploring the solution space more efficiently. Through a comparative analysis of a series of large-scale experimental cases, the results demonstrate that compared to the traditional NSGA2 algorithm, the LNS-NSGA2 algorithm effectively reduces distribution costs while significantly improving customer satisfaction. It can notably enhance the quality of the Pareto Frontier, providing superior distribution schemes for fresh food trading outlets and cold chain logistics enterprises.

articleTitle: Optimisation Study of VLSI Circuit Cell Placement Based on Rectilinear Minimum Steiner Tree and Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Large-scale integration (VLSI) integrates numerous circuit elements onto a single chip, significantly impacting Electronic Design Automation (EDA). This paper investigates the effects of wire length, circuit grid density, and routing density using Half-Perimeter Wire Length (HPWL) and Rectilinear Steiner Minimum Tree (RSMT) models. For wire length, Steiner points are iteratively added to the given set of coordinates for each group, and Kruskal's algorithm is applied to determine the minimum spanning tree with the shortest total wire length. The grey relational model is used to evaluate the solution based on grey relational coefficients. For grid density, the study divides the element density into three cases: single obstruction, multiple non-overlapping obstructions, and multiple overlapping obstructions. The objective function minimizes wire length, constrained by a grid density threshold of 0.9, with simulated annealing used for optimization. In routing density analysis, improvements to existing methods are proposed by calculating group-specific routing densities and overall grid routing density, using Matlab to compute overlapping regions and derive the final results.

Author Keywords: Minimum Steiner tree with straight line

articleTitle: Submarine Navigation and Communication Model Based on HMM and TDA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The enigmatic depths of the ocean have captivated adventurers for centuries, offering vast, untapped resources that continue to spur exploration and exploitation. In response to the challenges of underwater navigation, this paper introduces an innovative submersible navigation and communication model that integrates the Hidden Markov Model (HMM) with Tactical Decision Aid (TDA), harnessing the principle of spiral motion. This model facilitates seamless collaboration between human decision-makers and remotely operated vehicles (ROVs), ensuring safer and more efficient underwater operations. The HMM simulates various potential routes and computes the most optimal path for navigation, allowing for more accurate movement predictions. During the mission, the TDA is continuously updated with real-time acoustic data, enhancing both navigation precision and communication between the submersible and surface operators. By combining machine learning with TDA, the model provides decision-makers with precise guidance while maintaining confidence in the ROV's embedded intelligence. This integrated approach ensures reliable underwater operations, offering a promising solution for navigating the complexities of deep-sea exploration.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Vehicle Control Based on Model Predictive Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to improve control smoothness, this paper constructs a five-module model based on model predictive control algorithm, which integrates sensing, communication and decision modes, and focuses on solving the control problem of autonomous vehicles. Firstly, the decision logic of signal light is studied, and the switching mode of signal light is designed by state machine model. Secondly, the dynamics model of the autonomous vehicle is constructed, and the trajectory tracking is optimized through the MPC design control input, and the ride comfort and handling stability of the vehicle are analyzed. Finally, a five-module model is established for overall integration, and simulation experiments are carried out for intersection and autonomous vehicle under straight line driving, stopping and following state. The results show that the proposed collaborative optimization method significantly improves the efficiency of the traffic system and reduces the energy consumption, which verifies the effectiveness of the experimental platform.

articleTitle: An Enhanced BERT-CNN-BiLSTM-MH Model for NLP Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To address the shortcomings of the BERT-BiLSTM model in processing certain features, this study proposed an improved BERT-CNN-BiLSTM-MH model for topic classification tasks in specific scenarios. Specifically, to overcome the limitations in capturing local features, we introduced a CNN module to effectively extract key local features. Additionally, to tackle the problem of insufficient global feature representation in the BERT-CNN-BiLSTM model, we integrated a multi-head (MH) attention mechanism, which improved the model's capacity to capture long-range dependencies and diverse contextual information. This enhanced architecture aimed to provide better performance in topic classification tasks by addressing these key limitations. The proposed RoBERTa-CNN-BiLSTM-MH model was validated on CLUE TNEWS dataset, demonstrating strong topic classification capabilities. The model achieved a precision of 0.9102, a recall of 0.9207, an accuracy of 0.9092, and an F1 score of 0.9124, confirming its effectiveness. The BERT-CNN-BiLSTM-MH model significantly outperformed others. It showed an accuracy improvement of 9.41% over BERT-GRU-SE, 8.74% over RoBERTa CNN LSTM, 8.75% over BERT-CNN-GRU-SE, 6.66% over BERT LSTM Transformer, and 2.72% over BERT-CNN-BiLSTM-SE. The results validate the superiority of the proposed model over existing approaches. The RoBERTa-CNN-BiLSTM-MH model meets the requirements for accurate and efficient topic classification, demonstrating promising application prospects in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: A Combination Perception Model Based on CNN-BiGRU-Attention and Its Application in Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Deep learning-based long and short-term memory networks offer notable advantages in processing datasets that vary over time. Current models, however, face challenges such as poor information capture and overfitting/underfitting, especially with non-periodic patterns in long signals. To address these issues, this paper proposes an enhanced CNN-BiGRU-Attention model. This model integrates a convolutional neural network (CNN) for extracting spatial features, a bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BiGRU) for handling long-term dependencies, and an attention mechanism to highlight key information dynamically. The attention mechanism improves the model's focus on critical features within long sequences. Tested on the Sleep-EDF dataset, the model achieved an accuracy (ACC) of 73.25% and an F1 score of 72.24% on the training set. Compared to existing models, the proposed model shows a 5% increase in ACC and a 4% increase in F1 score, demonstrating its effectiveness in capturing complex patterns and focusing on essential details.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv8-CBAM Enhanced Pothole Road Recognition-Based Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of Intelligent Transport Systems, pavement condition monitoring plays an increasingly important role in the field of road maintenance and road safety. Especially in the automatic identification and repair of potholes, the traditional method often relies on manual inspection, which is not only inefficient but also easy to miss the inspection. To improve the accuracy and robustness of pothole road identification, this paper improves the YOLOv8 model and introduces the CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) module. To focus on important information, this paper divides the CBAM module into two parts: spatial attention mechanism and channel attention mechanism, in which the spatial attention mechanism uses the Recurrent Neural Network model to determine the focus of attention; and the channel attention mechanism uses the Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks model to determine the attention channel. The YOLOv8-CBAM Enhanced model is established by combining the YOLOv8 model and the CBAM module. Experiments show that the recognition accuracy reaches 99.29% on the validation set, and the algorithm YOLOv8-CBAM Enhanced model in this paper improves the accuracy by 5.79 % over YOLOv8, and at the same time, it takes only 25ms to complete the prediction of an image. The YOLOv8-CBAM Enhanced model has 99.29% confusion matrix accuracy on the training set. The advantages of the YOLOv8-CBAM Enhanced model are fully demonstrated. Compared with other models, the algorithm also achieves better detection results and can effectively accomplish the road pothole detection task, which fully demonstrates the advantages of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Face2Makeup: Generating Facial Makeup Images via Diffusion Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, the advancement of artificial intelligence technologies and diffusion models has significantly propelled the field of facial image analysis, particularly in facial reconstruction applications. In response to these developments, we propose the Face2Makeup model, which incorporates an image compression module to reduce computational resource requirements during training. Additionally, the model utilizes the F+roop module to control facial similarity, ensuring that the generated makeup aligns more closely with the user's facial features. Furthermore, we designed a Face+ESRGAN high-definition module to enhance image resolution, providing users with more accurate facial detail references. Finally, we contribute the C-makeup-gallery, a high-resolution, fine-grained facial makeup dataset, to address the limitations of existing datasets. Face2Makeup demonstrates superior performance in the makeup domain compared to existing models, as evidenced by the PSNR metric.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv8 and IMU-UWB Fusion for Enhanced Target Detection and Precise Positioning in Quadruped Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To address the challenges of target detection and precise positioning for quadruped robots in complex environments, this paper proposes a method that combines an improved YOLOv8 model with IMU-UWB integrated positioning technology. In terms of target detection, the YOLOv8 model was optimized by replacing the original backbone with the lightweight ShuffleNetV2 and removing certain convolutional modules, reducing parameters by 43% (from 11.17M to 6.39M) to enhance efficiency on embedded devices. While mAP50-95 dropped to 60.35%. The mAP50-95 dropped to 60.35%, which lead to a slight decrease of 7% compared to the original model. The model maintained high accuracy under less strict conditions with a mAP50 of 93.4%, comparable to the original's 93.8%. This optimization provides a balance between reduced computational complexity and robust detection performance for embedded applications. In terms of positioning technology, this paper integrates IMU and UWB technologies, utilizing an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) to achieve multi-sensor data fusion. This method fully leverages the dynamic response characteristics of IMU and the high-precision positioning capability of UWB, reducing positioning errors to within 0.5 meters, significantly enhancing the system's stability and robustness. The combination of these two methods greatly improves the perception capability and autonomy of quadruped robots in complex scenarios, demonstrating broad potential for applications in fields such as drone collaboration and autonomous driving.

articleTitle: Research on MRI Image Super-Resolution Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Information Distillation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning has demonstrated powerful capabilities in computer vision tasks and injected new energy into MRI image super-resolution reconstruction algorithms. However, existing MRI super-resolution methods based on 2D and 3D CNNs require interpolation to upsample low-resolution images, which increases the computational burden. To address this, this paper proposes an MRI image super-resolution algorithm based on information distillation, called DASID-SR. The algorithm uses information distillation to reduce network parameters and computational complexity while extracting deep features, and applies sub-pixel convolution for direct reconstruction and upsampling, thereby reducing the model's complexity. The core innovations include constructing a Mixed Information Distillation Module (M-IMDB), introducing a differentiable architecture search algorithm in the deep feature extraction module, and implementing dense connections between modules to enhance feature utilization efficiency. Experimental results show that on the Kirby21 and ALVIN-adult datasets, with a reconstruction factor of 3, the proposed method achieves peak signal-to-noise ratios (PSNR) of 40.21dB and 37.56dB, respectively, outperforming other networks by 0.02dB to 2.68dB and 0.02dB to 1.41dB. Moreover, the model's parameter size is only 0.45MB, demonstrating that the proposed algorithm can generate high-quality MRI images while maintaining a low parameter count.

articleTitle: A Multi-Strategy Integrated Improved YOLOv8n Algorithm and its Application in Real-Time Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The detection task of targets in YOLOv8n often suffers from insufficient recognition accuracy and insufficient scene applicability, which makes it difficult to accurately recognize targets in complex scenes. To do this, we propose a multi-strategy integrated optimization YOLOv8n algorithm to meet the needs of high accuracy and high scene adaptability for autonomous driving. Specifically, to address the problem of low adaptability of C2f in scenes with rich features, the ODConv module is introduced to improve the adaptability of the model. In view of the problems of high computational cost and limited optimization capability of the CIOU loss function processing, the Focal_GIOU loss function is introduced to improve the accuracy of the model for target localisation, and also enhance its ability to detect targets in complex scenes. Finally, Nadam optimizer is applied to replace the SGD optimizer to improve the training efficiency of the model. The proposed algorithm is applied to the COCO128 dataset for validation, and the experimental results show that the improved YOLOv8n algorithm proposed in this paper has the advantage of high detection efficiency. The mAP@0.5 of the model reaches 91.87%, the validity and applicability of the model are verified. Compared with other models, the growth advantage of mAP@0.5 is up to 6.23%, which proves the superiority of the model. The improved model proposed in this paper is used to solve the problem of insufficiently accurate target detection and low operational efficiency in unmanned vehicles, and has a good application background.

articleTitle: The Dual- Intent Group Recommendation Combining Hypergraph Convolution and Channel Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the growing popularity of online groups in social networks, group discovery has become a key factor in enhancing user experience and fostering platform development. However, existing recommendation methods face challenges in handling user participation in group discovery tasks, as they often overlook individual user interests and item preferences. To address this issue, we propose an innovative model called DIGE, which aims to understand the different intents behind users' participation in groups, including social intents and personal interest intents. Our model separately models these two types of intents and integrates them for prediction to comprehensively capture user behavior and group characteristics. In the model design, we introduce a hypergraph structure to better preserve group information, while employing a novel structural refinement method to reveal the complexity of user behavior and interests. By incorporating the ECA (Efficient Channel Attention) mechanism, we further enhance the model's focus on important features. Additionally, we observe the phenomenon of intent overlap in real-world scenarios and design a self-supervised learning loss to promote consistency in recommendations. The model was compared against baseline models such as CFAG on three public datasets-Mafengwo, Weeplaces, and Steam-and experimental results demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms existing methods.

articleTitle: Research of Volleyball Robot Based on YOLOv8 Lightweight and Binocular Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The study of volleyball robot capture mechanism is a challenging problem, and how to realize real-time and high-precision capture is the focus of current research. In order to solve these problems, this paper designs a capture system based on an improved YOLO model and binocular vision scheme for the study of volleyball robot capture mechanism. By improving faster as the backbone network and introducing the EMA attention mechanism, the YOLO model is realized to be lightweight, and the parameter computation is reduced by 26.5%, which ensures the real-time performance of the volleyball robot; meanwhile, the accuracy is improved by 1.1 %. On this basis, the improved YOLO is combined with an improved binocular vision scheme based on the principle of solving triangles to obtain the accurate world coordinate system of the volleyball relative to the disk, ensuring that the robot can solve the world coordinates of the volleyball in real time. In practical applications, the distance error within 2 meters is always kept within 1 cm, Through experimental verification, the design scheme in this paper can effectively improve the real-time and accuracy of the robot capture mechanism, and make an important contribution to the development of the robot capture mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on the Automated Deployment Inspection System for Business Systems Based on Cloud-Native Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Gated Recurrent Yum Actor-Critic (GRYAC) architecture innovatively integrates cloud native technology, gated cycle unit (GRU) neural network and Actor-Critic algorithm, providing a powerful tool for the research of online automated inspection system of business systems based on cloud native architecture. The GRYAC uses the GRU to capture the time series features of various indicators in the business system, and automatically adjusts the check policies to optimize the robustness and availability of the system through the reinforcement learning strategy of the Actor-Critic algorithm. We have built a system architecture based on IaaS, PaaS, SaaS three-layer cloud service model to provide comprehensive support for the deployment, operation and application of automated inspection system. Finally, through comparative experiments and analysis between the model algorithm and the neural network, this paper verifies that the proposed cloud-native architect-based online automated inspection system not only has significant advantages in accuracy, decision science and overall efficiency improvement, but also has significant improvements in accuracy, recall rate, accuracy rate and F1 score. The results show that the automatic inspection system can effectively solve the complexity and uncertainty problems that the traditional inspection methods are difficult to deal with, and it also proves the feasibility of the automatic inspection model in the online business system.

articleTitle: Channel Equalizer Research Based on Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In digital communication, data transmission is impacted by channel distortion. Inter-Symbol Interference (ISI) arises from the dispersive characteristics of the channel. To enhance reliability and support high-speed communication, channel equalization techniques are employed at the receiver to mitigate the effects of ISI. This paper proposes an effective equalizer, named CLE, which combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. As the terrestrial wireless channel is mainly affected by small-scale fading such as multipath fading and Doppler shift, the Rayleigh fading channel is modelled using the Jakes approach. Compared with traditional Decision-Feedback Equalizer (DFE), CLE can achieve the performance improvement of close to 4~6dB on the premise of reaching the same bit error rate. The experiment results show that CLE is more efficient and less complex than the equalizer with similar techniques, resulting in faster processing and reduced computational demands, making it more practical for real-world applications. It means that our method is better equipped to handle the fluctuations in channel conditions, maintaining reliable performance even as the environment changes.
